Even so, at Stonebreaker Hold, Rakoria awaits word of our progress.$B$BShe's sharp and capable, $N, but be careful around her. She's got a lot of goods she's eager to move along the roads, but don't assume she's got our best interests at heart. Rakoria goes where she believes there's profit to be found.
english.completion: I'd hoped his men would have the outpost complete sooner, but it's not costing him money. Still, it's progress.

text.title: 地狱火半岛的工事
text.objectives: 占领瞭望台、竞赛场和碎石岭，然后向地狱火半岛上荣耀堡内的委任官翠希·普罗维尔复命。
text.description: 地狱火堡垒与我们的军队一直有着小规模的冲突与交战。目前，我们自己的领地大多守备稳固，但一直没能对他们发动真正的进攻。为了筹备进攻，我们要首先占领地狱火堡垒外围的战略要地。$B$B我们的斥候目前确定了三处互成犄角之势的工事，希望你能协助这三处的防守。占领所有工事之后回来向我报告。$B$B愿你能在接下来的战斗中有好运气，$N，毫无疑问，你得面对部落的威胁，他们也同样想占领这三处重要的工事。
text.completion: Well done, $n.  Your actions in the field are instrumental in our battle for Hellfire Peninsula.
text.completed: Return to Warrant Officer Tracy Proudwell at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Hellfire Fortifications
english.objectives: Capture the Overlook, the Stadium and Broken Hill, then return to Warrant Officer Tracy Proudwell in Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.
english.description: The Hellfire Citadel wages constant battles with our forces.  We are holding our own so far, but we can't yet launch a real offensive against them.  To do that, we need forward staging areas.$B$BOur scouts identified three fortifications near Hellfire Citadel.  We want you to help secure these forts.  Capture each fort, and then report back to me.$B$BMay fortune shine upon you in the conflicts ahead, $N, for you will no doubt clash with Horde forces eager to gain these same fortifications.
english.completion: Well done, $n.  Your actions in the field are instrumental in our battle for Hellfire Peninsula.
english.completed: Return to Warrant Officer Tracy Proudwell at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 外交手段
text.objectives: Jorin Deadeye at Garadar in Nagrand has asked that you find and speak with Lantresor of the Blade in the Burning Blade Ruins.
text.description: Kilrath sends news of the Boulderfist leader: He is an orc! An ancient orc that passed through the Dark Portal in the time of our fathers and has since returned to his homeland. I wish for you to track down this orc and try to convince him to pull back the Boulderfist ogres. He resides on an upper platform in the Burning Blade Ruins to the southeast near the border of Terokkar. Good luck, $N!$B$BBe warned, he is a blademaster...
text.completion: So what is your decision? Will it be war or will you lend your assistance?
text.end: Hear the Tale of the Blademaster
text.completed: Return to Lantresor of the Blade at the Burning Blade Ruins in Nagrand.

english.title: Diplomatic Measures
english.objectives: Jorin Deadeye at Garadar in Nagrand has asked that you find and speak with Lantresor of the Blade in the Burning Blade Ruins.
english.description: Kilrath sends news of the Boulderfist leader: He is an orc! An ancient orc that passed through the Dark Portal in the time of our fathers and has since returned to his homeland. I wish for you to track down this orc and try to convince him to pull back the Boulderfist ogres. He resides on an upper platform in the Burning Blade Ruins to the southeast near the border of Terokkar. Good luck, $N!$B$BBe warned, he is a blademaster...
english.completion: So what is your decision? Will it be war or will you lend your assistance?
english.end: Hear the Tale of the Blademaster
english.completed: Return to Lantresor of the Blade at the Burning Blade Ruins in Nagrand.

text.title: 外交手段
text.objectives: 塔拉的击碎者姆摩尔要你去跟火刃废墟的兰特瑞索·火刃谈一谈。
text.description: 据女猎手的密探汇报，石拳部族的领主是位兽人！这位生活在我们父辈那个年代的兽人长者曾经跨越黑暗之门作战，回来后便一直居住在火刃废墟中。我想派你去寻找这位兽人的下落，并试着说服他召回石拳食人魔。此地东方就是火刃废墟，他就居住在废墟的上层平台。$N，祝你好运！$B$B当心，他是位剑圣……
text.completion: So what is your decision? Will it be war or will you lend your assistance?
text.end: Hear the Tale of the Blademaster
text.completed: Return to Lantresor of the Blade at the Burning Blade Ruins in Nagrand.

english.title: Diplomatic Measures
english.objectives: Mo'mor the Breaker at Telaar in Nagrand has asked that you find and speak with Lantresor of the Blade in the Burning Blade Ruins.
english.description: The huntress's agents send news of the Boulderfist leader: He is an orc! An ancient orc that passed through the Dark Portal in the time of our fathers and has since returned to his homeland. I wish for you to track down this orc and try to convince him to pull back the Boulderfist ogres. He resides on an upper platform in the Burning Blade Ruins to the east. Good luck, $N!$B$BBe warned, he is a blademaster...
english.completion: So what is your decision? Will it be war or will you lend your assistance?
english.end: Hear the Tale of the Blademaster
english.completed: Return to Lantresor of the Blade at the Burning Blade Ruins in Nagrand.

text.title: 我想要这些鸟蛋！
text.objectives: 将3份气元素实体交给纳格兰南部氏族岗哨对面的瓦萨特。
text.description: 瞧见那些鸟蛋了吗？以口臭的加兹鲁维的名义发誓，我一定要搞到这些蛋！唔，你看上去很能打的样子。$B$B$R，如果你能为我收集一样东西，等我调试好超级蹦床4000型，我就送你一把启动这玩意的钥匙！你想知道超级蹦床4000型有什么用处？有了这宝贝，你几乎什么都能做……$B$B我要你从纳格兰的大气元素身上收集气元素实体。别跟我说你找不到气元素，它们遍布整个纳格兰！
text.progress: Got gas?
text.completion: Excellent! Now just a few adjustments and this thing will be as good as new. Oh yes, your key! Here you go. By the way, the Jump-a-tron still has a few kinks that I need to work out. Um, just be careful.
text.completed: Return to Wazat in Nagrand.

english.title: I Must Have Them!
english.objectives: Wazat across from Clan Watch in southern Nagrand wants you to bring him 3 Air Elemental Gases.
english.description: Do you see them?? By Gazlowe's horrific halitosis, I will have those eggs! Say, you look like you might be of some use.$B$BI'll tell you what, $r; if you gather a few items for me to make my Jump-a-tron 4000 functional, I'll give you a key that will let you operate the machine as well! What can you do with a Jump-a-tron 4000 you say? What can't you do is more like it...$B$BI'll need air elemental gas from the air elementals of Nagrand. They're all over the place so don't ask me where to find 'em!
english.progress: Got gas?
english.completion: Excellent! Now just a few adjustments and this thing will be as good as new. Oh yes, your key! Here you go. By the way, the Jump-a-tron still has a few kinks that I need to work out. Um, just be careful.
english.completed: Return to Wazat in Nagrand.

text.title: 地狱火半岛的工事
text.objectives: 占领瞭望台、竞赛场和碎石岭，然后向地狱火半岛上萨尔玛的传令官布莱肯·黑眼复命。
text.description: 在我们的故乡肆虐的所有地狱火堡垒邪兽人都必须要消灭干净！但要想攻击地狱火堡垒，我们必须首先占领堡垒外围的几处战略要地。$B$B巡逻队发现有三处工事正好适合我们的目的。但联盟竟与我们不谋而合，现在已经派出部队占领了那里！$B$B我要求你立刻阻止联盟的行动，并占领这些工事。协助我军占领工事之后，立刻回来向我报告。$B$B为了部落！
text.completion: Nice work, $n.  I could almost hear the battles waged at those forts.  I wish I was there to see them!
text.completed: Return to Battlecryer Blackeye at Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Hellfire Fortifications
english.objectives: Capture the Overlook, the Stadium and Broken Hill, then return to Battlecryer Blackeye in Thrallmar.
english.description: The fel orcs of Hellfire Citadel must be scoured from our birthland!  To attack them, we must first secure forward staging points near the Citadel.$B$BOur outrunners found three fortifications that will suit this purpose, but the Alliance has the same idea and even now sends forces to take them!$B$BWe want you to stop the Alliance and capture these forts.  Aid in the capture of each fort and then return to me.$B$BFor the Horde!
english.completion: Nice work, $n.  I could almost hear the battles waged at those forts.  I wish I was there to see them!
english.completed: Return to Battlecryer Blackeye at Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 给我鸟蛋！
text.objectives: 纳格兰的瓦萨特要你利用超级蹦床4000型从附近树上的鸟巢中偷取神秘的鸟蛋。
text.description: 你已经拿到了钥匙，现在我要你从树上给我取一枚鸟蛋来！使用超级蹦床4000型跳上鸟巢。要小心！跳得不好的话难免会受伤流血，甚至可能永久残废呢。
text.progress: Did I mention my love for eggs?
text.completion: Well, it's no egg... Hey! I love chicken too! I'll just chomp right through this ginourmous talon! Thanks!
text.completed: Return to Wazat in Nagrand.

english.title: Bring Me The Egg!
english.objectives: Wazat in Nagrand wants you to use the Jump-a-tron 4000 to get to the nest in the nearby tree and steal the Mysterious Egg.
english.description: Now that you've been initiated, I want you to get me that egg! Use the Jump-a-tron and try to hit the nest dead center. But be careful! Bodily injury or serious permanent damage may occur from a bad jump.
english.progress: Did I mention my love for eggs?
english.completion: Well, it's no egg... Hey! I love chicken too! I'll just chomp right through this ginourmous talon! Thanks!
english.completed: Return to Wazat in Nagrand.

text.title: 私人事务
text.objectives: 将5箱拉斯莱的货物交给沙塔斯城贫民窟天涯旅店附近的星界商人拉斯莱。
text.description: 嗯？你说的是一盒东西？还是好几盒？你知道盒子是用什么材制成的吗？$B$B还有，这名商人叫什么来着？埃博尔？你确定他是个破碎者吗？我跟破碎者很少有贸易往来。$B$B如果你能帮我个忙，我或许能想起点什么。$B$B基斯鸦人是一群远古的施法者，最近他们从我这儿偷走了一批珍奇的货物。我要找回那批货物！$B$B基斯鸦人就聚集在沙塔斯城以南的基斯鸦巢。
text.progress: Hmm, is my memory improving?
text.completion: Yes, indeed, I do believe that it's all getting clearer now. And I think that your diligence in this matter deserves more than just the information that you seek.
text.completed: Return to Wind Trader Lathrai in the Lower City section of Shattrath City.

english.title: A Personal Favor
english.objectives: Retrieve 5 of Lathrai's Stolen Goods.  Return them to Wind Trader Lathrai near the World's End Tavern in the Lower City section of Shattrath City.
english.description: Hmmm?  A box you say?  Or was it several?  Do you know what material the box was constructed from?$B$BAnd what was the name of this merchant?  Empoor?  Are you certain that he's one of the Broken?  I don't do much business with their kind.$B$BPerhaps my memory would be jogged if you were to do me a favor?$B$BThe Skithian arakkoa - primitive casters that they are - recently stole a huge shipment of my more exotic goods.  I want it all back!$B$BYou can find Veil Skith just to the south of Shattrath City.
english.progress: Hmm, is my memory improving?
english.completion: Yes, indeed, I do believe that it's all getting clearer now. And I think that your diligence in this matter deserves more than just the information that you seek.
english.completed: Return to Wind Trader Lathrai in the Lower City section of Shattrath City.

text.title: 奈辛瓦里狩猎队
text.objectives: "Shotgun" Jones wants you to speak with Hemet Nesingwary at the Nesingwary Safari on the outskirts of northeast Nagrand.$B$B
text.description: "Go out and find us some supplies," he said. I was nearly killed about 15 times before I found this place! These Broken might not be the most hospitable bunch but at least they're not trying to tear my skin from my bones.$B$BAnyway, I'm not going back. My days of huntin' big game are over. If you end up heading northeast towards Zangarmarsh and run into the Nesingwary Safari, let them know that "Shotgun" quit. $B$BHey, maybe you can take my place! Good luck, stranger.$B$B
text.completion: I suppose we'll have to find a replacement water boy. Say, you look like a powerful $c. Interested in a job? Or did you come for the hunt?

english.title: The Nesingwary Safari
english.objectives: "Shotgun" Jones wants you to speak with Hemet Nesingwary at the Nesingwary Safari on the outskirts of northeast Nagrand.$B$B
english.description: "Go out and find us some supplies," he said. I was nearly killed about 15 times before I found this place! These Broken might not be the most hospitable bunch but at least they're not trying to tear my skin from my bones.$B$BAnyway, I'm not going back. My days of huntin' big game are over. If you end up heading northeast towards Zangarmarsh and run into the Nesingwary Safari, let them know that "Shotgun" quit. $B$BHey, maybe you can take my place! Good luck, stranger.$B$B
english.completion: I suppose we'll have to find a replacement water boy. Say, you look like a powerful $c. Interested in a job? Or did you come for the hunt?

text.title: 奈辛瓦里狩猎队
text.objectives: 欧洛恩·远行者要你前往纳格兰的奈辛瓦里狩猎队营地，跟“好儿子”沙度·远行者谈一谈。
text.description: These orcs have never seen a tauren before - if you can believe such a thing. If it weren't for Captain Kroghan, they would have probably been serving me for their next meal right about now.$B$BBut where are my manners? I am Ohlorn Farstrider, hunter extraordinaire! I am part of the Nesingwary expedition that came up here from Azeroth in search of big game. If you are interested in the hunt, perhaps you should visit my crew at the Nesingwary Safari, due east of here near the border of Zangarmarsh.$B$B
text.completion: I am relieved to hear that he is safe. Have you come to join the hunt?

english.title: The Nesingwary Safari
english.objectives: Ohlorn Farstrider wants you to speak with Shado 'Fitz' Farstrider at the Nesingwary Safari in Nagrand.
english.description: These orcs have never seen a tauren before - if you can believe such a thing. If it weren't for Captain Kroghan, they would have probably been serving me for their next meal right about now.$B$BBut where are my manners? I am Ohlorn Farstrider, hunter extraordinaire! I am part of the Nesingwary expedition that came up here from Azeroth in search of big game. If you are interested in the hunt, perhaps you should visit my crew at the Nesingwary Safari, due east of here near the border of Zangarmarsh.$B$B
english.completion: I am relieved to hear that he is safe. Have you come to join the hunt?

text.title: 匕潭的威胁
text.objectives: 杀死3个匕潭刺客和15个匕潭泥居者。
text.description: 库雷尼人和德莱尼人常常会出现意见分歧，尤其是在对待失落者的问题上。我们乐意去帮助那些向我们求助的失落者，但不会主动伸出援手。德莱尼人则想要使所有的失落者得到“救赎”。$B$B但是，某些失落者部族已经偏离了正道，例如匕潭失落者。此地西边就是他们的村落，匕潭失落者滥用毒药、善于欺诈，他们的恶行已经到了难以容忍的地步。$B$B我们必须好好教训这帮渣滓，不能任由他们胡作非为。
text.completion: You have done well, $n. The Daggerfen are beyond redemption by anyone's standards, but I'm not certain that the draenei would've acted with the proper speed in this situation.
text.completed: Return to Ikuti at the Orebor Harborage in Zangarmarsh.

english.title: Daggerfen Deviance
english.objectives: Slay 3 Daggerfen Assassins and 15 Daggerfen Muckdwellers.
english.description: The Kurenai and the draenei don't always see eye to eye, particularly on the issue of the Lost Ones. We are content to help the Lost Ones who seek us out, but we won't pursue them. Some draenei are intent on 'redeeming' them all.$B$BHowever, there are times when even the Lost Ones go too far, such as the Daggerfen. In their village to the west, they dabble in poisons and deceit, arts that come unnaturally to us.$B$BWe must put an end to this before the vile Daggerfen can extend their influence.
english.completion: You have done well, $n. The Daggerfen are beyond redemption by anyone's standards, but I'm not certain that the draenei would've acted with the proper speed in this situation.
english.completed: Return to Ikuti at the Orebor Harborage in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 通缉：穆玛基酋长
text.objectives: 将穆玛基酋长的图腾交给奥雷柏尔营地的伊库提。
text.description: Wanted: Chieftain Mummaki - leader of the foul and degenerate Lost One tribe of the Daggerfen, for his brutal attacks against the Orebor Harborage.$B$BThe chieftain and his band of assassins are responsible for the deaths of numerous Kurenai and draenei and should only be approached by seasoned combatants.$B$BTravelers are advised to avoid the Daggerfen Village area to the west of the Orebor Harborage.$B$BTo claim the bounty, present proof of the chieftain's demise to Ikuti.
text.progress: So you wish to claim the bounty on Chieftain Mummaki?
text.completion: Remarkable! There have been others who tried to claim the bounty, but they never returned. It's not hard to figure out what happened to them. I'm relieved that we'll no longer be troubled by Mummaki and his degenerates.
text.completed: Return to Ikuti at the Orebor Harborage in Zangarmarsh.

english.title: Wanted: Chieftain Mummaki
english.objectives: Bring Chieftain Mummaki's Totem to Ikuti at the Orebor Harborage.
english.description: Wanted: Chieftain Mummaki - leader of the foul and degenerate Lost One tribe of the Daggerfen, for his brutal attacks against the Orebor Harborage.$B$BThe chieftain and his band of assassins are responsible for the deaths of numerous Kurenai and draenei and should only be approached by seasoned combatants.$B$BTravelers are advised to avoid the Daggerfen Village area to the west of the Orebor Harborage.$B$BTo claim the bounty, present proof of the chieftain's demise to Ikuti.
english.progress: So you wish to claim the bounty on Chieftain Mummaki?
english.completion: Remarkable! There have been others who tried to claim the bounty, but they never returned. It's not hard to figure out what happened to them. I'm relieved that we'll no longer be troubled by Mummaki and his degenerates.
english.completed: Return to Ikuti at the Orebor Harborage in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 通缉：穆玛基酋长
text.objectives: 将穆玛基酋长的图腾交给暗影猎手德恩加。
text.description: Wanted: Chieftain Mummaki - leader of the foul and degenerate Lost One tribe of the Daggerfen, for his brutal attacks against Zabra'jin and its inhabitants.$B$BThe chieftain and his band of assassins are responsible for the deaths of numerous scouts and messengers and should only be approached by seasoned combatants.$B$BTravelers are advised to avoid the Daggerfen Village area to the northwest of Zabra'jin.$B$BTo claim the bounty, present proof of the chieftain's demise to Shadow Hunter Denjai.
text.progress: So you wish to claim the bounty on Chieftain Mummaki?
text.completion: You have my thanks, $n. I was beginning to think that I was going to have to take a substantial part of the garrison up there and deal with Mummaki myself. Of course, there's no telling what might have happened to Zabra'jin then.
text.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Denjai at Zabra'jin in Zangarmarsh.

english.title: Wanted: Chieftain Mummaki
english.objectives: Bring Chieftain Mummaki's Totem to Shadow Hunter Denjai.
english.description: Wanted: Chieftain Mummaki - leader of the foul and degenerate Lost One tribe of the Daggerfen, for his brutal attacks against Zabra'jin and its inhabitants.$B$BThe chieftain and his band of assassins are responsible for the deaths of numerous scouts and messengers and should only be approached by seasoned combatants.$B$BTravelers are advised to avoid the Daggerfen Village area to the northwest of Zabra'jin.$B$BTo claim the bounty, present proof of the chieftain's demise to Shadow Hunter Denjai.
english.progress: So you wish to claim the bounty on Chieftain Mummaki?
english.completion: You have my thanks, $n. I was beginning to think that I was going to have to take a substantial part of the garrison up there and deal with Mummaki myself. Of course, there's no telling what might have happened to Zabra'jin then.
english.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Denjai at Zabra'jin in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 警告匕潭失落者
text.objectives: 杀死3个匕潭刺客和15个匕潭泥居者，然后返回萨布拉金向暗影猎手德恩加复命。
text.description: 在赞加沼泽的所有失落者部族中，匕潭失落者以狡猾和侵略性著称。他们的组织性极强，从不掩饰想控制沼泽地中其他失落者的野心。$B$B死在他们手中的斥候和信使已经不计其数，我再也经不起任何人员伤亡了。$B$B如果我们不赶快采取行动的话，他们就会完全控制萨布拉金附近的所有通道。
text.completion: I think you've managed to send a fairly strong message to them. Perhaps now, the rest of my men won't be so afraid to take the fight to the Daggerfen. Or, if they are, they'll find themselves ashamed by their lack of bravery.
text.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Denjai at Zabra'jin in Zangarmarsh.

english.title: Message to the Daggerfen
english.objectives: Slay 3 Daggerfen Assassins and 15 Daggerfen Muckdwellers and return to Shadow Hunter Denjai at Zabra'jin.
english.description: Of all the Lost One tribes in Zangarmarsh, the Daggerfen are the most cunning and most aggressive. They are highly organized and make no secret of the fact that they desire control over the other Lost Ones in the marsh.$B$BTheir attacks have already taken quite a toll on my scouts and messengers. I cannot afford to lose any more men.$B$BIf we don't act soon, they'll have complete control over the roads and Zabra'jin will effectively be surrounded.
english.completion: I think you've managed to send a fairly strong message to them. Perhaps now, the rest of my men won't be so afraid to take the fight to the Daggerfen. Or, if they are, they'll find themselves ashamed by their lack of bravery.
english.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Denjai at Zabra'jin in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 穿越黑暗之门
text.objectives: Travel through the Dark Portal and find Commander Duron. He awaits your arrival on the other side - in the Outland.$B$B
text.description: 20年来，黑暗之门一直是一座无声的纪念碑，对一段早已被忘却的历史的纪念。$B$B<雷索恩环视四周。>$B$B我从未想到过自己会看到这一天的到来，但是我们就站在这里，望向无底的深渊。$B$B我们的军队在黑暗之门的另一侧陷入混战，如果得不到支援的话，我们很可能会输掉这场残酷的战争。$C，你必须跨越黑暗之门，伸出援手。$B$B立即向指挥官杜隆报到吧。他就在外域等着你……
text.completion: Welcome to Outland, $n -- welcome to the nightmare! Though the initial Expeditionary Force made it through unscathed, the Legion is attempting to retake the Dark Portal and prevent any of our reinforcements from coming through. As much as I'd like your aid here, our troops and the Horde soldiers are able to fend off the Legion platoons that are attempting to take control of this platform. We need you where your talents can best be utilized.

english.title: Through the Dark Portal
english.objectives: Travel through the Dark Portal and find Commander Duron. He awaits your arrival on the other side - in the Outland.$B$B
english.description: For 20 years the Dark Portal has remained a silent monument - a eulogy to a time long since forgotten.$B$B<Relthorn looks around.>$B$BI never thought to see this day, yet here we stand, looking into the abyss.$B$BOn the other side of this gate we are locked in a savage war - a war that we cannot win without support. You must go through the Dark Portal and help our troops, $c.$B$BReport to Commander Duron at once. He awaits you in Outland...
english.completion: Welcome to Outland, $n -- welcome to the nightmare! Though the initial Expeditionary Force made it through unscathed, the Legion is attempting to retake the Dark Portal and prevent any of our reinforcements from coming through. As much as I'd like your aid here, our troops and the Horde soldiers are able to fend off the Legion platoons that are attempting to take control of this platform. We need you where your talents can best be utilized.

starters.name: 守望堡指挥官雷索恩·奈瑟维

text.title: 抵达外域
text.objectives: 地狱火半岛上黑暗之门旁的沃雷恩中将要求你将沃雷恩的报告交给维拉加·乱羽。
text.description: 有了联盟的帮助，我的部队会守住这条阵线，但是我需要你帮我送一份报告给萨尔玛的克拉库克将军。有了他的帮助，我们就能把这些恶魔送回到他们的深渊去！去和我们身后平台上的维拉加·乱羽聊聊吧，她会给你一些必要的指引。
text.progress: I saw you speaking with Orion - it must be important business...
text.completion: So you're Orion's new messenger? I pray you fare better than the last one he sent, $c.  With the Legion pressing in, you'd never make it to Thrallmar on foot. Say the word, and my faithful wyvern will deliver you there safely.
text.completed: Speak with Vlagga Freyfeather at the Stair of Destiny in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Arrival in Outland
english.objectives: Lieutenant General Orion at the Dark Portal in Hellfire Peninsula wants you to bring Orion's Report to Vlagga Freyfeather.
english.description: Aided by the Alliance, my forces will hold the line here, but I need you to deliver my report to General Krakork in Thrallmar. With his help, we'll be able to drive these demons back into the abyss that spawned them! Speak to Vlagga Freyfeather who stands on the platform behind us. She'll speed you on your way.
english.progress: I saw you speaking with Orion - it must be important business...
english.completion: So you're Orion's new messenger? I pray you fare better than the last one he sent, $c.  With the Legion pressing in, you'd never make it to Thrallmar on foot. Say the word, and my faithful wyvern will deliver you there safely.
english.completed: Speak with Vlagga Freyfeather at the Stair of Destiny in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 消灭燃烧军团
text.objectives: 前往萨尔玛以东的补给车队，与斯古尔·碎颅者中士谈一谈。
text.description: 这里到处都是新的敌人，但燃烧军团仍旧是我们远征军最大的威胁。我最信赖的一位军官——斯古尔·碎颅者中士最近一直在研究燃烧军团的战术，也试图了解他们来到这里的真正目的。去南墙外的补给车队那里找他吧。$B$B$N，一定要小心燃烧军团。千万别低估了这群阴险狡诈的东西。
text.completion: No doubt you saw the Legion's warriors dotting the landscape on your flight from the Dark Portal. Though we defeated them at the Battle of Mount Hyjal some five years past, the cursed demons just keep coming back for more. If it's a challenge they crave, then the Horde will answer in kind! We orcs have more than just a score to settle with the Legion. What about you, $n? Shall I tell you of our enemy?
text.completed: Speak with Sergeant Shatterskull at the Supply Caravan in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Eradicate the Burning Legion
english.objectives: Speak with Sergeant Shatterskull at the Supply Caravan just outside of Thrallmar, to the east.
english.description: Though this land is full of strange new enemies, the Burning Legion is still the greatest threat to our Expedition. One of my most trusted warriors, Sergeant Shatterskull, has been studying the Legion's tactics - trying to discern the demons' true purpose in this land. Seek him out at the supply caravan just outside the southern wall.$B$BAnd $n - be wary of the Legion. Their evil cannot be underestimated.
english.completion: No doubt you saw the Legion's warriors dotting the landscape on your flight from the Dark Portal. Though we defeated them at the Battle of Mount Hyjal some five years past, the cursed demons just keep coming back for more. If it's a challenge they crave, then the Horde will answer in kind! We orcs have more than just a score to settle with the Legion. What about you, $n? Shall I tell you of our enemy?
english.completed: Speak with Sergeant Shatterskull at the Supply Caravan in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 堡垒的外围
text.objectives: Search the northernmost camp along the Southern Rampart for any trace of Private Imarion.
text.description: Each day, Hellfire Citadel opens its gates, and more fel orcs pour out and into the camps they've established along the ramparts south of the fortress.$B$BI dispatched one of my most capable scouts, Private Imarion, to track their movements, preparations and numbers, but he hasn't returned to report his findings.$B$BImarion was to focus his efforts on the northernmost camp along the Southern Rampart, near where it joined the Citadel. Find him, $N. Without his information, we're sitting ducks.

english.title: The Citadel's Reach
english.objectives: Search the northernmost camp along the Southern Rampart for any trace of Private Imarion.

Find him, $N. Without his information, we're sitting ducks.

text.title: 魔火峡谷
text.objectives: 萨尔玛东侧补给车队的斯古尔·碎颅者中士要求你杀死4个唤火小鬼、6个地狱火战争使者和1个恐惧召唤者。
text.description: 末日领主卡扎克是外域一带燃烧军团的最高指挥官。虽然我们现在还没有办法直接去挑战卡扎克，但我们可以先斩除他的左臂右膀——那些燃烧军团的高级军官。$B$B目前，有一队恐惧魔王驻扎在东边的魔火峡谷，他们负责指挥和制造那些在我们头顶上飞来飞去的地狱火。去干掉他们和他们的手下，燃烧军团会因此受到重创。
text.completion: Outstanding work, soldier. The frequency of the attacks is sure to lessen - at least until they bring forth more dreadlords. Now for the bad news: I've got your new orders...
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Shatterskull at the Supply Caravan in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Felspark Ravine
english.objectives: Sergeant Shatterskull at the Supply Caravan east of Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula wants you to kill 4 Flamewaker Imps, 6 Infernal Warbringers and 1 Dreadcaller.
english.description: Doom Lord Kazzak commands the Burning Legion in Outland. While we can't get to Kazzak - yet - we can and must get to his lieutenants that command Legion troops from the ground.$B$BThey have stationed dreadlords in Felspark Ravine, east of here. They are responsible for these infernal storms that rain down upon our heads. To take them and their minions out would be a great set back to the Burning Legion.
english.completion: Outstanding work, soldier. The frequency of the attacks is sure to lessen - at least until they bring forth more dreadlords. Now for the bad news: I've got your new orders...
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Shatterskull at the Supply Caravan in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 机甲残骸
text.objectives: 前往机甲残骸，向前线指挥官托尔克报到。
text.description: Your battle prowess has been noted by high command, $c. They want to send you to the front lines to meet up with Maimfist's crew. They're radicals, devoted to the complete extermination of the Burning Legion, so you may fit right in...$B$BHead east about 200 paces and veer south at the jutting mass of land. You'll see Reaver's Fall where an old farm used to stand. Once there, you are to report to Forward Commander To'arch.$B$BNow move out!
text.completion: So you're the one responsible for clearing out Felspark, eh?  That's good to hear - we need soldiers like you who can take these fiends head on!
text.completed: Report to Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.objectives: Report to Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall.

english.completed: Report to Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: Mission: Disrupt Communications
text.objectives: Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall in Hellfire Peninsula has asked that you use To'arch's Explosives and destroy Legion Antenna: Spite, Legion Antenna: Rage, Legion Antenna: Hate, Legion Antenna: Fear.
text.description: Directly east of here is the Legion Front. The front acts as a mobile command station for the Burning Legion. Jutting out of the ground you'll see Legion antennas. The Legion uses these to communicate with their forge camps throughout Outland. They also serve as wards to scramble Legion transmissions, making magical surveillance impossible.$B$BI want you to take these explosives and use them to obliterate the antennas. Get all of them, $N. They run south to north on the border of the Legion Front.
text.completed: Return to Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 指挥官奈克罗格的命令
text.objectives: Travel south along the west side of the South Rampart and search the next camp for signs of Private Imarion.
text.description: The orders, signed by 'Warboss Nekrogg,' order the fel orc patrols stationed at this camp to bring their human prisoner south for interrogation.$B$BLieutenant Amadi mentioned that the Southern Rampart is dotted with fel orc camps. Perhaps the next large section of the wall to the south is where they took Private Imarion.$B$BJudging by the note's mention of interrogation, it seems the private's fel orc captors see some value in keeping him alive. Pick up the trail before they decide to change their minds.

english.objectives: Travel south along the west side of the South Rampart and search the next camp for signs of Private Imarion.

text.title: Mission: Sever the Tie
text.objectives: Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall in Hellfire Peninsula wants you to kill 4 Fel Handlers, 8 Wrathguards, and Subjugator Shi'aziv.
text.description: It would be a dereliction of duty if I did not order you to take out the demons that inhabit the Legion Front, just east of this base.$B$BBoth sides of the front are set up in the same manner: Fel handlers roam between Legion encampments, which are in turn guarded by wrathguards. A shivan subjugator oversees the entire operation. Kill 'em all and let Kazzak sort 'em out.$B$BAnd watch out for patrolling fel reavers. I know you're tough but those things will make short work of you.
text.completed: Return to Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: Saving Private Imarion
text.objectives: Continue south along the Southern Rampart and search for where Warboss Nekrogg is holding Private Imarion.
text.description: The tracks lead south from Imarion's equipment, appearing to follow the Southern Rampart. The roughness of the shallow ruts suggests that Imarion's captors were in a hurry to move him to his next destination, but why?$B$BWas someone waiting there for him, perhaps the Warboss Nekrogg, the leader named in the orders you found further north?$B$BThe shield and the tracks raise more questions than they solve, but it seems certain that where you find Private Imarion, you're likely to find Warboss Nekrogg too.

text.title: 任务：穆尔凯斯和沙德拉兹之门
text.objectives: 与空军指挥官布拉克谈谈，轰炸穆尔凯斯之门和沙德拉兹之门，然后向机甲残骸处的前线指挥官托尔克复命。
text.description: 我们已经找到了燃烧军团目前所使用的两条运输增援军的主要线路：穆尔凯斯和沙德拉兹之门。$B$B如果你沿着荣耀之路一直向西走，就可以在路边看见它们了。而我要你做的，就是把它们都给我炸上天！$B$B这是你要用的炸弹，是我请52区的一个地精技师特别设计的。现在，去和空军指挥官布拉克谈一谈，他会给你分配一只双足飞龙的。
text.progress: If you missed during your first pass, take another...
text.completion: That will set them back weeks! Fantastic work, $n. The Legion never expected such heavy resistance.
text.completed: Return to Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Mission: Gateways Murketh and Shaadraz
english.objectives: Speak with Wing Commander Brack, bomb Gateway Murketh and Gateway Shaadraz and then return to Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall.
english.description: We've identified the two main transporters that the Burning Legion are using to bring in reinforcements: Gateway Murketh and Gateway Shaadraz.$B$BIf you look east up the Path of Glory, you'll see them on either side of the road.  I want you to bomb them both into oblivion!$B$BHere are the bombs you'll use, specially designed by a goblin in Area 52.  Now, speak with Wing Commander Brack -- he'll put you on a wyvern.
english.progress: If you missed during your first pass, take another...
english.completion: That will set them back weeks! Fantastic work, $n. The Legion never expected such heavy resistance.
english.completed: Return to Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 西侧的威胁
text.objectives: Kill 10 Shattered Hand Guards, 10 Shattered Hand Berserkers, and 5 Shattered Hand Acolytes, then report to Lieutenant Amadi at Honor Hold's western guard tower.
text.description: In addition to other instructions, the orders tell the remaining fel orcs to prepare their equipment and rations for a coming attack.$B$BAccording to the plans, Warboss Nekrogg's forces are to form the western flank of a pincer attack on Honor Hold.$B$BWith the hold's garrison concentrating on its eastern walls, an attack from the west would be devastating. Honor Hold can only hope to hold out if the western forces are kept out of the battle.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Amadi at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: The Western Flank
english.objectives: Kill 10 Shattered Hand Guards, 10 Shattered Hand Berserkers, and 5 Shattered Hand Acolytes, then report to Lieutenant Amadi at Honor Hold's western guard tower.

Honor Hold can only hope to hold out if the western forces are kept out of the battle.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Amadi at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: Planning the Escape
text.objectives: Kill a Shattered Hand Grenadier and bring his Crude Explosives to Private Imarion at Gor'gaz Outpost.
text.description: Like I said, getting out of here won't be easy. Warboss Nekrogg may look like an overgrown brute, but he's no simpleton.$B$BHe won't let the cage key out of his sight and doesn't come down from his tower atop that chunk of wall until he's ready to question me or that orc he's managed to capture.$B$BIt's going to take something extraordinary to get him off that wall, but I have an idea. Find one of the grenadiers that patrol the ground along the Southern Rampart and bring me some of his explosives.
text.completed: Return to Private Imarion at Southern Rampart in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 巨人的威胁
text.objectives: 杀死5个暴怒的巨人，然后返回地狱火半岛的塞纳里奥哨站，向图拉希恩复命。
text.description: You see that huge red crystal to the north?  It fell from the sky not long ago, causing a massive earthquake.$B$BWhen we came out here to investigate the disturbance, we found all of these colossi wandering about that weren't previously here.$B$BThere's definitely something strange about that crystal and the energies that it's emanating, but I don't have time for that.  Those mountain giants are my immediate concern.$B$BI want you to head up to Fallen Sky Ridge with some friends and deal with them.
text.completion: Good work. If you ask me, all that we have to do is kill enough of those colossi, and then we won't have to worry any longer about the ridge or that strange crystal in the middle of it. Here, take one of these as a gift from the Cenarion Expedition.
text.completed: Return to Tola'thion at the Cenarion Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Colossal Menace
english.objectives: Slay 5 Raging Colossi and then return to Tola'thion at the Cenarion Post in Hellfire Peninsula.
english.description: You see that huge red crystal to the north?  It fell from the sky not long ago, causing a massive earthquake.$B$BWhen we came out here to investigate the disturbance, we found all of these colossi wandering about that weren't previously here.$B$BThere's definitely something strange about that crystal and the energies that it's emanating, but I don't have time for that.  Those mountain giants are my immediate concern.$B$BI want you to head up to Fallen Sky Ridge with some friends and deal with them.
english.completion: Good work. If you ask me, all that we have to do is kill enough of those colossi, and then we won't have to worry any longer about the ridge or that strange crystal in the middle of it. Here, take one of these as a gift from the Cenarion Expedition.
english.completed: Return to Tola'thion at the Cenarion Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: Mission: Kill the Messenger
text.objectives: Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall in Hellfire Peninsula has asked that you find and slay Arix'malidash and recover the Legion Missive.
text.description: 你的手艺已经导致军团非常不舒服，N美元。 我的侦察员刚刚通知我，军团已经通过快递发送通讯。 我们已经成功地从主机上切断了他们的部队！接下来我要求你的是我的B$BW比一个普通士兵要求的更多。$B$BThe Legion信使从Aggonar游泳池前往Forge Base：Mageddon ，在这里北。 你必须拦截Mageddon的快递员，处理他，然后带着Legion信件回到我身边。
text.completed: Return to Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Mission: Kill the Messenger
english.objectives: Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall in Hellfire Peninsula has asked that you find and slay Arix'malidash and recover the Legion Missive.
english.description: Your handiwork is already causing the Legion great discomfort, $N. My scouts have just informed me that the Legion has resorted to sending communication via courier. We have successfully managed to cut their troops off from the host!$B$BWhat I ask of you next is more than I would ask of an ordinary soldier.$B$BThe Legion courier travels from the Pools of Aggonar to Forge Base: Mageddon, north of here. You must intercept the courier at Mageddon, dispose of him, and return to me with the Legion missive.
english.completed: Return to Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 火红水晶中的线索
text.objectives: 将火红水晶碎片交给地狱火半岛塞纳里奥哨站的图拉希恩。
text.description: 当这个巨人在你面前缓缓倒下时，突然一小块水晶碎片从它身上掉了下来。$B$B尽管这块碎片映衬在山丘巨人那庞大身躯旁是那么的渺小，但你还注意到了它。拾起它之后，你感到它非常的沉重。似乎它是从坠星山那块巨大的水晶上的散落下来的碎片。$B$B这显然是一个线索，能使大家了解清楚这里为什么会发生那么多奇怪的事。你认为南边塞纳里奥哨站的德鲁伊一定会想研究研究这块碎片。
text.progress: That's a big crystal you have there.  Did you get that while you were up at the ridge killing colossi? Let me take a look at it.
text.completion: Hmph.  Just looks like a big lump of unrefined crystal to me. Admittedly, I can feel a sickly, evil aura emanating off of it, but that's not exactly in my line of work.  I'm just here to put an end to the mountain giant menace.

english.title: Crimson Crystal Clue
english.objectives: Deliver the Crimson Crystal Shard to Tola'thion at the Cenarion Post in Hellfire Peninsula.
english.description: As the colossus falls under the weight of your attacks, you notice for the first time that it was holding a red crystal fragment.$B$BWhile it was small and unnoticeable in the mountain giant's hand, it's a fairly hefty piece for you to carry around.  It also suspiciously looks like it's a piece of the giant crystal in the middle of the ridge.$B$BIt's most definitely a clue as to the strangeness that is occurring here, and you're sure that the druids at the Cenarion Post to the south will want to see it.
english.progress: That's a big crystal you have there.  Did you get that while you were up at the ridge killing colossi? Let me take a look at it.
english.completion: Hmph.  Just looks like a big lump of unrefined crystal to me. Admittedly, I can feel a sickly, evil aura emanating off of it, but that's not exactly in my line of work.  I'm just here to put an end to the mountain giant menace.

text.title: Mission: Be the Messenger
text.objectives: Take the Legion Missive to Nazgrel at Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.
text.description: I am merely a field commander, $c. The authority to act on this kind of information falls squarely on the shoulders of our leader, Nazgrel. You must take this missive to him in Thrallmar. Ride with the wind at your back, soldier. Let nothing prevent you from reaching Nazgrel!

english.title: Mission: Be the Messenger
english.objectives: Take the Legion Missive to Nazgrel at Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.
english.description: I am merely a field commander, $c. The authority to act on this kind of information falls squarely on the shoulders of our leader, Nazgrel. You must take this missive to him in Thrallmar. Ride with the wind at your back, soldier. Let nothing prevent you from reaching Nazgrel!

text.title: 阿拉修斯的意图
text.objectives: 除掉残酷的阿拉修斯，然后返回萨尔玛向纳兹格雷尔复命。
text.description: 魔导师文森特·血鹰破译了你之前找到的燃烧军团信件。看来这份计划书是大领主卡扎克麾下的军官——残酷的阿拉修斯所拟。很明显阿拉修斯统领着燃烧军团部署在地狱火半岛的陆军。是时候终结他的统帅权了，$N。用武力去结束这一切。$B$B到西边的阿苟纳之池去，干掉这个所谓的“燃烧军团领主”。今天，部落将要夺回地狱火半岛，让燃烧军团见鬼去吧！
text.completion: For generations to come, they will sing songs of this day, $N - songs of your valor. I wish Thrall had been here to celebrate this victory with us. The Legion is undone - and Hellfire now belongs to the Horde once again! There may yet be hope for this ravaged world - and our peoples' place within it. $B$BLok'tar ogar!  $B$B
text.completed: Return to Nazgrel at Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Cruel's Intentions
english.objectives: Kill Arazzius the Cruel, then return to Nazgrel in Thrallmar.
english.description: Magister Bloodhawk finally deciphered the Legion missive you found earlier. It turned out to be attack plans sent by one of Highlord Kazzak's lieutenants - Arazzius the Cruel. Apparently, Arazzius commands the Legion ground forces in Hellfire. The time has come to terminate his command, $N. Terminate with extreme prejudice. $B$BHead west to the Pools of Aggonar and put an end to this so-called 'Legion lord'. Today, the Horde reclaims Hellfire Peninsula. Let the Legion be damned.
english.completion: For generations to come, they will sing songs of this day, $N - songs of your valor. I wish Thrall had been here to celebrate this victory with us. The Legion is undone - and Hellfire now belongs to the Horde once again! There may yet be hope for this ravaged world - and our peoples' place within it. $B$BLok'tar ogar!  $B$B
english.completed: Return to Nazgrel at Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: Provoking the Warboss
text.objectives: Use the Crude Explosives to create a disturbance and lure Warboss Nekrogg out of his tower. Kill him, obtain Nekrogg's Key, and use it to open Private Imarion's cage. Once you have freed Private Imarion, report to Lieutenant Amadi.
text.description: The plan succeeds or fails on how well these explosives are made...$B$BAs much as I'd hate to rely on anything made by an orc, it's my only real chance to get out of here. Take this and throw it against the banner hanging from the tower up there.$B$BOnce it explodes, Warboss Nekrogg won't be able to resist the chance to make an example of the troublemaker. Kill him, take the key, and then open my cage. Good luck, $N.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Amadi at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Provoking the Warboss
english.objectives: Use the Crude Explosives to create a disturbance and lure Warboss Nekrogg out of his tower. Kill him, obtain Nekrogg's Key, and use it to open Private Imarion's cage. Once you have freed Private Imarion, report to Lieutenant Amadi.
english.description: The plan succeeds or fails on how well these explosives are made...$B$BAs much as I'd hate to rely on anything made by an orc, it's my only real chance to get out of here. Take this and throw it against the banner hanging from the tower up there.$B$BOnce it explodes, Warboss Nekrogg won't be able to resist the chance to make an example of the troublemaker. Kill him, take the key, and then open my cage. Good luck, $N.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Amadi at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: Under Whose Orders?
text.objectives: Kill 20 Shattered Hand Grunts, 10 Shattered Hand Warlocks, and capture Drillmaster Zurok's Orders. Then, return to Lieutenant Amadi at Honor Hold's western guard tower.
text.description: One thing is clear, $N: we can't keep this up. The fel orcs have us surrounded and as quickly as we can kill them, several spring up to replace them. We can't hope to win this war huddled behind Honor Hold's shattered walls and counting the days until our deaths at the hands of the fel orcs or the Legion.$B$BYou've done a remarkable job of sparing us from the brunt of the fel orc attack, but now you must fight your way up the Path of Glory and learn who is orchestrating these attacks.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Amadi at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Under Whose Orders?
english.objectives: Kill 20 Shattered Hand Grunts, 10 Shattered Hand Warlocks, and capture Drillmaster Zurok's Orders. Then, return to Lieutenant Amadi at Honor Hold's western guard tower.

We can't hope to win this war huddled behind Honor Hold's shattered walls and counting the days until our deaths at the hands of the fel orcs or the Legion.$B$BYou've done a remarkable job of sparing us from the brunt of the fel orc attack, but now you must fight your way up the Path of Glory and learn who is orchestrating these attacks.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Amadi at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: Dispatching the Commander
text.objectives: Slay Force-Commander Gorax and report to Lieutenant Amadi at Honor Hold's western tower.
text.description: From what I can tell, Drillmaster Zurok served as the right hand of the fel orc leader in Hellfire Peninsula, Force-Commander Gorax.$B$BThis Gorax isn't your typical fel orc brute, though. I almost admire the way he managed to keep us on the defensive for so long.$B$BZurok's orders indicate that Gorax's command center is located at the end of the Path of Glory, near where the citadel's walls meet the Northern Rampart. There's no telling what to expect, $N, but it would be wise to travel with allies.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Amadi at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 荣耀堡之旅
text.objectives: 乘座狮鹫前往荣耀堡，将杜隆的报告交给伊斯多尔元帅。
text.description: 如果你准备好了的话，我就要为你安排一次直接到荣耀堡的飞行了。$B$B到了那边以后，和伊斯多尔元帅谈谈，然后把杜隆的报告交给他。看到又一位来自故乡的新兵，他一定会很高兴的。而且，我得说，这份报告也非常重要！
text.progress: Thank the Light you made it here safely. Honor Hold needs all the seasoned warriors it can muster.
text.completion: Our expedition to this forsaken, wreck of a world has almost ground to a halt, $n. We encountered more resistance than we bargained for. As if facing the Burning Legion again wasn't bad enough - there are horrors in this land unlike anything we've ever encountered.

english.title: Journey to Honor Hold
english.objectives: Take a flight to Honor Hold and deliver Duron's Report to Marshal Isildor.
english.description: When you're ready, I'll arrange a flight straight to Honor Hold.$B$BFrom there, speak with Marshal Isildor and give him Duron's report.  He'll be happy to see another recruit from the homelands, and I'm sure the information in that report is important stuff!
english.progress: Thank the Light you made it here safely. Honor Hold needs all the seasoned warriors it can muster.
english.completion: Our expedition to this forsaken, wreck of a world has almost ground to a halt, $n. We encountered more resistance than we bargained for. As if facing the Burning Legion again wasn't bad enough - there are horrors in this land unlike anything we've ever encountered.

text.title: 重生的军团
text.objectives: 与荣耀堡外面的东补给车队的沃图姆斯中士谈一谈。
text.description: 当燃烧军团入侵艾泽拉斯世界时，他们在外域这里也没闲着。多年来，我们都在追踪着他们的活动。但是，$C，这次他们最新的行动却是我们以前完全没有见过的。$B$B立刻到东补给车队去，找沃图姆斯中士报到。她负责对那些入侵者执行具体的监视行动，并分析他们的行动目的。$B$B你要快一点行动，同时也要注意安全，$N，绝对不要低估燃烧军团。
text.completion: Force Commander Danath may have misunderstood my request for reinforcements. You look capable, but... I asked for a full sized battalion! You see, we have a bit of a demon problem...
text.completed: Talk to Sergeant Altumus at the East Supply Caravan in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: The Legion Reborn
english.objectives: Speak with Sergeant Altumus at the East Supply Caravan just outside of Honor Hold, to the east.
english.description: While the Burning Legion invaded Azeroth, they were also at work here, in Outland.  We have tracked their movements over the years, but this latest activity, $c - well, this is beyond anything we've seen.$B$BSeek out Sergeant Altumus near the eastern supply caravan. She has been monitoring the invaders and may have insights into their purpose.$B$BBe swift - and take care, $n - the Burning Legion is not to be underestimated.
english.completion: Force Commander Danath may have misunderstood my request for reinforcements. You look capable, but... I asked for a full sized battalion! You see, we have a bit of a demon problem...
english.completed: Talk to Sergeant Altumus at the East Supply Caravan in Hellfire Peninsula.

starters.name: 远征军指挥官达纳斯·托尔贝恩

text.title: 苦痛之路
text.objectives: 荣耀堡外面的东补给车队的沃图姆斯中士要求你杀死4只唤火小鬼、6只地狱火战争使者和1只恐惧召唤者。
text.description: 末日领主卡扎克指挥着外域所有的燃烧军团部队。当然，我们目前还不能直接和卡扎克对抗，但我们可以——而且必须——开始铲除他军团中的军官，彻底扰乱他们的指挥体系。$B$B他们在东边的苦痛之路派驻了一批恐惧魔王。正是这些恐惧魔王负责着在我们头顶上不停地降下地狱火之雨。立刻清除他们，还有他们的手下，这样燃烧军团就将遭受重大的损失。
text.completion: Outstanding work, soldier. The frequency of the attacks is sure to lessen - at least until they bring forth new dreadlords. Now for the bad news: I've got your new orders...
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Altumus at the East Supply Caravan in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: The Path of Anguish
english.objectives: Sergeant Altumus at the East Supply Caravan east of Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula wants you to kill 4 Flamewaker Imps, 6 Infernal Warbringers and 1 Dreadcaller.
english.description: Doom Lord Kazzak commands the Burning Legion in Outland. While we can't get to Kazzak - yet - we can and must get to his lieutenants that command Legion troops from the ground.$B$BThey have stationed dreadlords at the Path of Anguish, east of here. They are the ones responsible for these infernal storms that rain down upon our heads. To take them and their minions out would be a great set back to the Burning Legion.
english.completion: Outstanding work, soldier. The frequency of the attacks is sure to lessen - at least until they bring forth new dreadlords. Now for the bad news: I've got your new orders...
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Altumus at the East Supply Caravan in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 远征军岗哨
text.objectives: 向远征军岗哨的前线指挥官金斯顿报到。
text.description: 你在之前数次作战之中所体现出的战斗力，已经被所有的高级指挥官注意到了，$C。他们希望能派你去前线与罗哈姆斯的小分队会合。那是一群激进分子，对毁灭燃烧军团的事业非常狂热。或许……你在他们那里会感觉比较自在一点……$B$B向东前进大约400步的距离，穿越白骨之谷，走到一处被毁坏的魔能机甲旁，远征军岗哨就矗立在那边的一处燃烧军团基地旧址上。到达那里之后，立刻向前线指挥官金斯顿报到。$B$B去吧！
text.completion: Glad to meet you, soldier. Enough chatting... now listen up -- I have a vital mission for you and I want you to succeed... and survive!
text.completed: Report to Forward Commander Kingston at Expedition Point in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Expedition Point
english.objectives: Report to Forward Commander Kingston at Expedition Point.
english.description: Your battle prowess has been noted by high command, $c. They want to send you to the front lines to meet up with Rohamus's crew. They're radicals, devoted to the complete extermination of the Burning Legion, so you may fit right in...$B$BHead east about 400 paces, across the Valley of Bones, until you run into a destroyed fel reaver. You'll see Expedition Point where a Legion base used to stand. Once there, you are to report to Forward Commander Kingston.$B$BNow move out!
english.completion: Glad to meet you, soldier. Enough chatting... now listen up -- I have a vital mission for you and I want you to succeed... and survive!
english.completed: Report to Forward Commander Kingston at Expedition Point in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 阻断援军
text.objectives: 消灭格雷姆传送门和凯勒兹传送门附近的敌人，收集它们身上的恶魔符文石。$B$B然后在格雷姆传送门和凯勒兹传送门内使用金斯顿的雷管。$B$B完成任务后，将剩余的炸药还给前线指挥官金斯顿。
text.description: 你从这里一直向西北方走，就可以到达军团前线。那里部署着许多通向外域各地的传送门，使这里的燃烧军团能够随时得到增援。$N，我们决定摧毁所有的传送门！$B$B带上这捆雷管，它是由52区的技师设计的，可以利用恶魔自身的力量产生强大的爆炸！首先你要杀死格雷姆传送门和凯勒兹传送门旁边的那些军团士兵，收集他们身上的恶魔符文石，然后在传送门内使用雷管去引爆这些符文石……接下来，我们就可以看烟火表演了！！$B$B快去吧，$N，完成任务之后向我复命。
text.progress: I wish I could be there to watch the fire display.  Those explosives pack a big punch!
text.completion: Well done, $n.  Disabling those portals will stem the flow of Legion reinforcements for a long time! But we can't rest yet...
text.completed: Return to Forward Commander Kingston at Expedition Point in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Disrupt Their Reinforcements
english.objectives: Defeat enemies around Portal Grimh and Portal Kaalez to gather Demonic Rune Stones.$B$BUse Kingston's Primer inside Portal Grimh and Portal Kaalez.$B$BReturn to Forward Commander Kingston with the remaining explosives.
english.description: You'll find the Legion front to our northeast, and spaced along it are portals used to gather reinforcements from throughout Outland. We, $n, are going to destroy those portals!$B$BTake this primer.  Designed in Area 52, it uses the demons' own power as an explosive device!  Defeat Legion forces around Portals Grimh and Kaalez to gather demonic rune stones, use the primer to detonate the stones inside the portals... then watch the fireworks!!$B$BGo, $n, and return to me when your mission is complete.
english.progress: I wish I could be there to watch the fire display.  Those explosives pack a big punch!
english.completion: Well done, $n.  Disabling those portals will stem the flow of Legion reinforcements for a long time! But we can't rest yet...
english.completed: Return to Forward Commander Kingston at Expedition Point in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: Mission: Sever the Tie UNUSED
text.objectives: Forward Commander Kingston at Expedition Point in Hellfire Peninsula wants you to kill 4 Fel Handlers, 8 Wrathguards, and Subjugator Yalqiz.
text.description: It would be a dereliction of duty if I did not order you to take out the demons that inhabit the Legion Front, just north of this base.$B$BBoth sides of the front are set up in the same manner: Fel handlers roam between Legion encampments, which are in turn guarded by wrathguards. A shivan subjugator oversees the entire operation. Kill 'em all and let Kazzak sort 'em out.$B$BAnd watch out for patrolling fel reavers. I know you're tough but those things will make short work of you.
text.completed: Return to Forward Commander Kingston at Spinebreaker Mountains in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.objectives: Forward Commander Kingston at Expedition Point in Hellfire Peninsula wants you to kill 4 Fel Handlers, 8 Wrathguards, and Subjugator Yalqiz.

I know you're tough but those things will make short work of you.
english.completed: Return to Forward Commander Kingston at Spinebreaker Mountains in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 任务：穆尔凯斯和沙德拉兹之门
text.objectives: 与空军指挥官达比利谈谈，轰炸穆尔凯斯之门和沙德拉兹之门，然后向远征军岗哨的前线指挥官金斯顿复命。
text.description: 就在黑暗之门的西边，有两处巨大的传送装置，它们分别被称作穆尔凯斯之门和沙德拉兹之门。$B$B如果你沿着荣耀之路一直向西走，就可以在路边看见它们了。而我要你做的，就是把它们都给我炸上天！$B$B这是你要用的炸弹，是我请52区的一个地精技师特别设计的。现在，去和空军指挥官达比利谈谈吧，他会用狮鹫把你一路送过去的。
text.progress: This is a vital mission, $n.  It's one I would not trust to just anyone.
text.completion: That will slow them down, there's no denying it! I think you just put me in an uncharacteristically good mood, $n!
text.completed: Return to Forward Commander Kingston at Expedition Point in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Mission: The Murketh and Shaadraz Gateways
english.objectives: Speak with Wing Commander Dabir'ee, bomb Gateway Murketh and Gateway Shaadraz and then return to Forward Commander Kingston at Expedition Point.
english.description: Just west of the Dark Portal are two huge transporters: Gateway Murketh and Gateway Shaadraz.$B$BIf you look east up the Path of Glory, you'll see them on either side of the road.  I want you to bomb them both into rubble!$B$BHere are the bombs you'll use, specially designed by a goblin in Area 52.  Now, speak with Wing Commander Dabir'ee -- he'll put you on a gryphon and send you on your way.
english.progress: This is a vital mission, $n.  It's one I would not trust to just anyone.
english.completion: That will slow them down, there's no denying it! I think you just put me in an uncharacteristically good mood, $n!
english.completed: Return to Forward Commander Kingston at Expedition Point in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: Mission: Kill the Messenger
text.objectives: Forward Commander Kingston at Expedition Point in Hellfire Peninsula has asked that you find and slay Arix'malidash and recover the Legion Missive.
text.description: Your handiwork is already causing the Legion great discomfort, $N. My scouts have just informed me that the Legion has resorted to sending communication via courier. We have successfully managed to cut their troops off from the host!$B$BWhat I ask of you next is more than I would ask of an ordinary soldier.$B$BThe Legion courier travels from the Pools of Aggonar to Forge Base: Mageddon, far north of here. You must intercept the courier at Mageddon, dispose of him, and return to me with the Legion missive.
text.completed: Return to Forward Commander Kingston at Spinebreaker Mountains in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.objectives: Forward Commander Kingston at Expedition Point in Hellfire Peninsula has asked that you find and slay Arix'malidash and recover the Legion Missive.

You must intercept the courier at Mageddon, dispose of him, and return to me with the Legion missive.
english.completed: Return to Forward Commander Kingston at Spinebreaker Mountains in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: Mission: Be the Messenger
text.objectives: Take the Legion Missive to Force Commander Danath Trollbane at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.
text.description: I am merely a field commander, $c. The authority to act on this kind of information falls squarely on the shoulders of our leader, Force Commander Danath Trollbane. You must take this missive to him in Honor Hold. Ride with the wind at your back, soldier. Let nothing prevent you from reaching Danath!

english.title: Mission: Be the Messenger
english.objectives: Take the Legion Missive to Force Commander Danath Trollbane at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.
english.description: I am merely a field commander, $c. The authority to act on this kind of information falls squarely on the shoulders of our leader, Force Commander Danath Trollbane. You must take this missive to him in Honor Hold. Ride with the wind at your back, soldier. Let nothing prevent you from reaching Danath!

text.title: Mission: End All, Be All
text.objectives: Force Commander Danath Trollbane at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula has asked that you slay Arazzius the Cruel.$B$B
text.description: Do you know what would have happened if you had not intercepted this missive, $N?$B$B<Danath nods.>$B$BThe entirety of the Legion army in Hellfire would have been knocking on our door. There is no way that we could have survived such an assault.$B$BThere is only one way to make sure that these orders never reach the Legion Front. You must travel to the Pools of Aggonar, far northwest of here, and slay this Arazzius creature.$B$BDo this and I will grant you a commendation.
text.completed: Return to Force Commander Danath Trollbane in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Mission: End All, Be All
english.objectives: Force Commander Danath Trollbane at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula has asked that you slay Arazzius the Cruel.$B$B

You must travel to the Pools of Aggonar, far northwest of here, and slay this Arazzius creature.$B$BDo this and I will grant you a commendation.
english.completed: Return to Force Commander Danath Trollbane in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 堡垒的外围
text.objectives: Search the northernmost camp along the Northern Rampart for any trace of Scout Makha.
text.description: Each day, Hellfire Citadel opens its gates, and more fel orcs pour out and into the camps they've established along the ramparts south of the fortress.$B$BI dispatched one of my most capable trackers, Scout Makha, to track their movements, preparations and numbers, but she hasn't returned to report her findings.$B$BMakha was to focus her efforts on the northernmost camp along the Northern Rampart, near where it ends in the rocks. Find her, $N. Without her information, we're sitting ducks.

english.title: The Citadel's Reach
english.objectives: Search the northernmost camp along the Northern Rampart for any trace of Scout Makha.
english.description: Each day, Hellfire Citadel opens its gates, and more fel orcs pour out and into the camps they've established along the ramparts south of the fortress.$B$BI dispatched one of my most capable trackers, Scout Makha, to track their movements, preparations and numbers, but she hasn't returned to report her findings.$B$BMakha was to focus her efforts on the northernmost camp along the Northern Rampart, near where it ends in the rocks. Find her, $N. Without her information, we're sitting ducks.

text.title: 指挥官奈克罗格的命令
text.objectives: Travel south along the west side of the Northern Rampart and search the next camp for signs of Scout Makha
text.description: The orders, signed by 'Warboss Nekrogg,' order the fel orc patrols stationed at this camp to bring their orcish prisoner south for interrogation.$B$BShadow Hunter Ty'jin mentioned that the Northern Rampart is dotted with fel orc camps. Perhaps the next large section of the wall to the south is where they took Scout Makha.$B$BJudging by the note's mention of interrogation, it seems the scout's fel orc captors see some value in keeping her alive. Pick up the trail before they decide to change their minds.

english.title: Warboss Nekrogg's Orders
english.objectives: Travel south along the west side of the Northern Rampart and search the next camp for signs of Scout Makha
english.description: The orders, signed by 'Warboss Nekrogg,' order the fel orc patrols stationed at this camp to bring their orcish prisoner south for interrogation.$B$BShadow Hunter Ty'jin mentioned that the Northern Rampart is dotted with fel orc camps. Perhaps the next large section of the wall to the south is where they took Scout Makha.$B$BJudging by the note's mention of interrogation, it seems the scout's fel orc captors see some value in keeping her alive. Pick up the trail before they decide to change their minds.

text.title: 西侧的威胁
text.objectives: Kill 10 Shattered Hand Guards, 10 Shattered Hand Berserkers, and 5 Shattered Hand Acolytes, then report to Stone Guard Ambelan at Spinebreaker Post near Zeth'Gor.
text.description: In addition to other instructions, the orders tell the remaining fel orcs to prepare their equipment and rations for a coming attack.$B$BAccording to the plans, Warboss Nekrogg's forces are to form the western flank of a pincer attack on Thrallmar.$B$BWith the town's garrison concentrating on its eastern walls, an attack from the west would be devastating. Thrallmar can only hope to hold out if the western forces are kept out of the battle.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Ambelan at Spinebreaker Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.objectives: Kill 10 Shattered Hand Guards, 10 Shattered Hand Berserkers, and 5 Shattered Hand Acolytes, then report to Stone Guard Ambelan at Spinebreaker Post near Zeth'Gor.

Thrallmar can only hope to hold out if the western forces are kept out of the battle.
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Ambelan at Spinebreaker Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: Saving Scout Makha
text.objectives: Continue south across the Path of Glory to the Southern Rampart and search for where Warboss Nekrogg is holding Scout Makha.
text.description: The tracks lead south from Makha's equipment, appearing to cross the Path of Glory. The roughness of the shallow ruts suggests that Makha's captors were in a hurry to move her to the next destination, but why?$B$BWas someone waiting there for her, perhaps Warboss Nekrogg, the leader named in the orders you found further north?$B$BThe shield and the tracks raise more questions than they solve, but it seems certain that where you find Scout Makha, you're likely to find Warboss Nekrogg too.

text.title: Planning the Escape
text.objectives: Kill a Shattered Hand Grenadier and bring his Crude Explosives to Scout Makha at Gor'gaz Outpost.
text.description: Like I said, getting out of here won't be easy. Warboss Nekrogg may look like an overgrown brute, but he's no simpleton.$B$BHe won't let the cage key out of his sight and doesn't come down from his tower atop that chunk of wall until he's ready to question me or that human he's managed to capture.$B$BIt's going to take something extraordinary to get him off that wall, but I have an idea. Find one of the grenadiers that patrol the ground along the Southern Rampart and bring me some of his explosives.
text.completed: Return to Scout Makha at Southern Rampart in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Planning the Escape
english.objectives: Kill a Shattered Hand Grenadier and bring his Crude Explosives to Scout Makha at Gor'gaz Outpost.
english.description: Like I said, getting out of here won't be easy. Warboss Nekrogg may look like an overgrown brute, but he's no simpleton.$B$BHe won't let the cage key out of his sight and doesn't come down from his tower atop that chunk of wall until he's ready to question me or that human he's managed to capture.$B$BIt's going to take something extraordinary to get him off that wall, but I have an idea. Find one of the grenadiers that patrol the ground along the Southern Rampart and bring me some of his explosives.
english.completed: Return to Scout Makha at Southern Rampart in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: Provoking the Warboss
text.objectives: Use the Crude Explosives to create a disturbance and lure Warboss Nekrogg out of his tower. Kill him, obtain Nekrogg's Key, and use it to open Scout Makha's cage. Once you have freed Scout Makha, report to Stone Guard Ambelan at Spinebreaker Post near Zeth'Gor.
text.description: The plan succeeds or fails on how well these explosives are made...$B$BAs much as I'd hate to rely on anything made by a fel orc, it's my only real chance to get out of here. Take this and throw it against the banner hanging from the tower up there.$B$BOnce it explodes, Warboss Nekrogg won't be able to resist the chance to make an example of the troublemaker. Kill him, take the key, and then open my cage. Good luck, $N.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Ambelan at Spinebreaker Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

Kill him, take the key, and then open my cage. Good luck, $N.
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Ambelan at Spinebreaker Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: Under Whose Orders?
text.objectives: Kill 20 Shattered Hand Grunts, 10 Shattered Hand Warlocks, and capture Drillmaster Zurok's Orders. Then, return to Stone Guard Ambelan at Spinebreaker Post.
text.description: One thing is clear, $N: we can't keep this up. The fel orcs have us pinned down and as quickly as we can kill them, several spring up to replace them. We can't hope to win this war with our forces divided and locked in constant combat with the fel orcs and the demons of the Legion.$B$BYou've done a remarkable job of blunting the fel orc attack, but now you must fight your way up the Path of Glory and learn who is orchestrating this offensive.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Ambelan at Spinebreaker Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: Dispatching the Commander
text.objectives: Slay Force-Commander Gorax and report to Shadow Hunter Ty'jin at Thrallmar.
text.description: From what I can tell, Drillmaster Zurok served as the right hand of the fel orc leader in Hellfire Peninsula, Force-Commander Gorax.$B$BThis Gorax isn't your typical fel orc brute, though. I almost admire the way he managed to keep us on the defensive for so long.$B$BZurok's orders indicate that Gorax's command center is located at the end of the Path of Glory, near where the citadel's walls meet the Northern Rampart. There's no telling what to expect, $N, but it would be wise to travel with allies.
text.completed: Return to Shadow Hunter Ty'jin at Thrallmar in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 血环补给品
text.objectives: Destroy 6 piles of Bleeding Hollow Supplies and report to Stone Guard Ambelan at Spinebreaker Post.
text.description: The orcish ruins of Zeth'Gor to serve as a base for an ever-growing tide of orcs emerging from Hellfire Citadel.$B$BShadow Hunter Ty'jin sent me here to keep an eye on the outpost and its strange inhabitants.$B$BSomething has changed these orcs, augmented them in a way we've never seen before. We have to do anything we can to keep them from strengthening. Fight your way into Zeth'Gor and destroy any supplies you find there.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Ambelan at Spinebreaker Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

We have to do anything we can to keep them from strengthening. Fight your way into Zeth'Gor and destroy any supplies you find there.

text.title: 扫清棘牙岭！
text.objectives: 杀死8只棘牙掠食者和8只棘牙喷毒者，然后返回地狱火半岛的塞纳里奥哨站，向玛霍拉姆·硬蹄复命。
text.description: 我们目前正为扫清那些棘牙岭的掠食者而战。毕竟，如果我们这里与赞加沼泽庇护所之间的联系被完全切断，事态就太过糟糕了。$B$B其实，我们并也不想将这些生物全部赶出家园，但它们经常袭击这里的旅行者，而且最近变得越来越具备攻击性，因此，我们已经没有其它选择了。$B$B如果你愿意帮忙的话，就太好了。
text.completion: With the ravagers cleared, travelers to and from the Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh should have an easier time of it. The Cenarion Expedition is indebted to you.
text.completed: Return to Mahuram Stouthoof at the Cenarion Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Keep Thornfang Hill Clear!
english.objectives: Kill 8 Thornfang Ravagers and 8 Thornfang Venomspitters, and then return to Mahuram Stouthoof at the Cenarion Post in Hellfire Peninsula.
english.description: We've been fighting an ongoing battle to keep the pass through Thornfang Hill to the west clear of ravagers.  It would be bad if we were to become completely cut off from the refuge in Zangarmarsh.$B$BWe don't want to displace the creatures, but there seems to be little choice as their attacks on travelers through the area have become more aggressive.$B$BClear some of the ravagers out of there if you can.
english.completion: With the ravagers cleared, travelers to and from the Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh should have an easier time of it. The Cenarion Expedition is indebted to you.
english.completed: Return to Mahuram Stouthoof at the Cenarion Post in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 知己知彼
text.objectives: 与荣耀堡西部哨塔内的阿曼蒂中尉谈一谈。
text.description: 有传闻说，最近战场出现了一批新的兽人，而且他们的数量还在不断增加。相对于我们一直以来面对的那些兽人，这群新兽人体型更加巨大，性格也更加残忍与狡猾。如果这个传闻是真的，那们我们原本就已势单力薄的军队恐怕根本无法与之抗衡。$B$B我已经委托深得我信任的阿曼蒂中尉前去调查这个传闻。如果你愿意在这危机关头帮助我们的话，就请直接去找她吧。她的分队目前驻扎在荣耀堡西边那处古老的哨塔里。$B$B$N，离开荣耀堡后一定要格外小心，你将要面对的是一个完全陌生而又充满危险的新世界。
text.completion: Good, we need all the help we can get. The increasing fel orc presence around the Southern Rampart concerns me. I sent out a scout to investigate, but he hasn't yet returned.

english.title: Know your Enemy
english.objectives: Speak with Lieutenant Amadi at the old guard tower just west of Honor Hold.
english.description: Rumors have surfaced that some new breed of orc is on the rise. Larger, meaner - more cunning than the brutes we're familiar with.  If these rumors are true then our forces, already stretched, may be taxed beyond their limit.$B$BI have entrusted my lieutenant, Amadi, with investigating this matter. If you would help us in this dark hour, seek her out. She is stationed at the broken tower just west of the Hold.$B$BAnd $N - be careful out there. You're heading into a dangerous new world.
english.completion: Good, we need all the help we can get. The increasing fel orc presence around the Southern Rampart concerns me. I sent out a scout to investigate, but he hasn't yet returned.

starters.name: 远征军指挥官达纳斯·托尔贝恩

text.title: 以防万一……
text.objectives: 将30块飞艇碎片交给飞艇坠毁点的“尖嗓子”斯克里·拉克希德。
text.description: 身为一名飞艇的艇长，在遇到紧急情况时，特别是当你的副驾驶只愿意服从来自胃部的命令时，你必须要保持头脑的冷静。$B$B比如现在，我就很冷静。我这里有一个好消息和一个坏消息，好消息是我们不必等待好几天才有替换零件可用；坏消息呢，就是我们的“备用零件”从这里一直散落到了东边的白骨之谷。$B$B啊，还有没有其它的坏消息？ 好吧，简单来说，备用零件已经没有了。嗯，对，在我们迫降的时候，零件全都掉落出去了。你能帮我把它们收集回来吗？这样我们就能把这玩意给修好了。
text.progress: Did you find enough of the parts? If not, I might have to use that frying pan Legassi keeps waving around. Then, I'd have to rename the zeppelin the "Flying Skillet."
text.completion: Some of this is in pretty bad shape, but there should be enough to work with here. With some creative engineering, I'm confident I can make it work!
text.completed: Return to "Screaming" Screed Luckheed at the Zeppelin Crash in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: In Case of Emergency...
english.objectives: Collect 30 pieces of Zeppelin Debris and bring them to "Screaming" Screed Luckheed at the Zeppelin Crash.
english.description: In the event of an emergency, it's always the pilot's job to keep a level head, especially when the only orders your co-pilot follows come from his stomach.$B$BThe good news is that we won't need to wait days for replacement parts to be imported. The bad news is that the "spare" parts got scattered from here to the Valley of Bones to the east.$B$BThe other bad news? The spare parts aren't so spare. They, uh, fell off during our rapid descent. Could you help me collect enough to get us off the ground again?
english.progress: Did you find enough of the parts? If not, I might have to use that frying pan Legassi keeps waving around. Then, I'd have to rename the zeppelin the "Flying Skillet."
english.completion: Some of this is in pretty bad shape, but there should be enough to work with here. With some creative engineering, I'm confident I can make it work!
english.completed: Return to "Screaming" Screed Luckheed at the Zeppelin Crash in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 任务：地狱岩床
text.objectives: 地狱火半岛机甲残骸的前线指挥官托尔克要求你杀死20个甘尔葛苦工和5个莫尔葛监工，并摧毁5门邪能火炮。
text.description: 既然你现在已经可以飞行了，或许你会对另一个轰炸任务感兴趣？$B$B我们已经孤立了燃烧军团的主要生产区域，就在铸魔营地的正北方。而你要做的事情，就是乘坐双足飞龙去那里，炸掉那些该死的东西！$B$B这是给你的炸弹——当你准备好了的时候就去跟空军指挥官布拉克谈一谈。
text.progress: Show them that not even the skies are safe!
text.completion: You fly as if you've been doing this your entire life, $n. Outstanding performance out there! Not even a scratch on the wyvern destroyers!
text.completed: Return to Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Mission: The Abyssal Shelf
english.objectives: Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall in Hellfire Peninsula has asked that you destroy 20 Gan'arg Peons, 5 Mo'arg Overseers and 5 Fel Cannons.
english.description: Now that you've got your wings, perhaps you'd be interested in running another bombing mission?$B$BThis time we've isolated the Legion's main production area, behind the forge camps to the north. I need you to get on a wyvern and destroy the whole damned thing!$B$BHere are your bombs - now, talk to Wing Commander Brack when you're ready for takeoff.
english.progress: Show them that not even the skies are safe!
english.completion: You fly as if you've been doing this your entire life, $n. Outstanding performance out there! Not even a scratch on the wyvern destroyers!
english.completed: Return to Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 任务：地狱岩床
text.objectives: 地狱火半岛破碎岗哨的空军指挥官格莱芬加尔要求你杀死20个甘尔葛苦工和5个莫尔葛监工，并摧毁5门邪能火炮。
text.description: Now that you've got your wings, perhaps you'd be interested in running another bombing mission?$B$BThis time we've isolated the Legion's main production area, behind the forge camps to the north. I need you to get on a gryphon and destroy the whole damned thing!$B$BHere are your bombs - now, talk to Gryphoneer Windbellow when you're ready for takeoff.$B$B
text.progress: Show them that not even the skies are safe!
text.completion: You fly as if you've been doing this your entire life, $n. Outstanding performance out there! Not even a scratch on the gryphon destroyers!
text.completed: Return to Wing Commander Gryphongar at Shatter Point in Hellfire Peninsula.

I need you to get on a gryphon and destroy the whole damned thing!$B$BHere are your bombs - now, talk to Gryphoneer Windbellow when you're ready for takeoff.$B$B
