text.title: 危险的荒野
text.objectives: Slay 12 Grovestalker Lynxes.
text.description: 我们目前正在全力进行着活木林生态环境的培育，但这里的山猫数量有些超出了控制范围。$B$B虽然林地山猫的数量曾经处于比较稳定的状态，但是现在它们已经威胁到了希尔瓦纳的生存空间，并可能导致许多令人不愉快的事情。$B$B我现在甚至怀疑拉什鸦巢的那群鸦人正是此事的幕后黑手，但现在，最迫切的问题还是来自于这些山猫本身。$B$B若是你能帮助我们解决这个问题，那可就真是太好了。
text.completion: That was fast.  Are you sure that you dealt with as many as was necessary? Excellent, there's something else that you can help us with if you are willing?
text.completed: Return to Rina Moonspring at Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: The Encroaching Wilderness
english.objectives: Slay 12 Grovestalker Lynxes.
english.description: We've been growing the Living Grove at an accelerated rate, but somehow the lynxes there have become lost to our control.$B$BWhere once their population was stable, the grovestalker lynxes are now beginning to encroach upon Sylvanaar, and there have been a number of unpleasant incidents of late.$B$BI suspect that the arakkoa of Veil Lashh are somehow behind it, but the immediate issue is with the lynxes themselves.$B$BI would be most grateful if you would help us to deal with this situation.
english.completion: That was fast.  Are you sure that you dealt with as many as was necessary? Excellent, there's something else that you can help us with if you are willing?
english.completed: Return to Rina Moonspring at Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 徘徊的恶狼
text.objectives: Collect 4 Thunderlord Dire Wolf Tails.
text.description: 那些肮脏污秽的部落在东边建立了一处定居点。他们还带了一大群恐狼来，估计要用来看家或是当作座骑。$B$B这些野兽经常冲过桥来劫掠和骚扰我们的营地。它们甚至捕食了我们的许多精灵龙，这已经严重影响了活木林内所有植物的授粉，影响到了它们的生长和繁殖。$B$B你立刻从这里东侧出镇，越过血槌峡谷上的桥，到东边的锯齿山去猎杀那里的狼群，记得将它们的尾巴砍下来作为证据！
text.progress: I cannot stress strongly enough the need for those Thunderlord dire wolves to be dealt with.  Their very existence endangers the stability of the Living Grove and all of our work here.
text.completion: Good.  I'll see if I can fashion something useful from these tails. No doubt that the Horde will find a way to replenish the numbers of their wolf pack, but for now we can breathe a little easier. $n, if you are willing there's something else that I would ask of you in defense of Sylvanaar and the Living Grove.
text.completed: Return to Rina Moonspring at Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: Marauding Wolves
english.objectives: Collect 4 Thunderlord Dire Wolf Tails.
english.description: The filthy races of the Horde have taken over a settlement to the east.  They've brought with them a large pack of the dire wolves that they prefer to use as mounts and sentries.$B$BThese sentries have been marauding across the bridge that separates us.  They've been stalking our fey drakes, which are critical to the pollination of the Living Grove.$B$BUse the east exit to traverse the bridge over Bloodmaul Ravine that leads to the Jagged Ridge to the east, and bring me their tails as proof!
english.progress: I cannot stress strongly enough the need for those Thunderlord dire wolves to be dealt with.  Their very existence endangers the stability of the Living Grove and all of our work here.
english.completion: Good.  I'll see if I can fashion something useful from these tails. No doubt that the Horde will find a way to replenish the numbers of their wolf pack, but for now we can breathe a little easier. $n, if you are willing there's something else that I would ask of you in defense of Sylvanaar and the Living Grove.
english.completed: Return to Rina Moonspring at Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 自我保护
text.objectives: Use Rina's Bough on 5 of the Grove Seedlings to summon forth defenses for the Living Grove.
text.description: 尽管你已经为防卫活木林做出了许多卓越的贡献，但我还是觉得这处新的家园需要更多的保护。$B$B拜托你，带上这棵已被我灌注入自然之力的小树苗。只要在那些被我埋下了种子的地方使用它，它就会令种子迅速成长，破土而出，成为强大的树人卫士。$B$B这些树人卫士对于林地的防御体系来说相当重要，既然你选择了希尔瓦纳作为长期的住所，想必你也会很重视这套防御体系。
text.progress: How fares the bolstering of the Living Grove's defenses? With the intentions of the arakkoa at Veil Lashh unknown, and the Horde just on the other side of the ravine, I fear that if we do not move quickly we will find ourselves in a poor situation to protect our new home and our work in the grove.
text.completion: Now that you have strengthened the grove's defenses, I feel much safer. You've earned our thanks and appreciation, $n. Of course, it just occurred to me that there's something else that we need to take care of!
text.completed: Return to Rina Moonspring at Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: Protecting Our Own
english.objectives: Use Rina's Bough on 5 of the Grove Seedlings to summon forth defenses for the Living Grove.
english.description: Though you've done a great deal of good work in defense of our new home here, I still feel that the Living Grove needs more protection.$B$BPlease, take this small tree bough that I have imbued with the force of nature.  When used upon the seedlings that I have planted out in the grove, it will call down a storm to accelerate the growth of a treant defender.$B$BThese treants are critical to the defense of the grove, especially if you choose not to make Sylvanaar your home for long.
english.progress: How fares the bolstering of the Living Grove's defenses? With the intentions of the arakkoa at Veil Lashh unknown, and the Horde just on the other side of the ravine, I fear that if we do not move quickly we will find ourselves in a poor situation to protect our new home and our work in the grove.
english.completion: Now that you have strengthened the grove's defenses, I feel much safer. You've earned our thanks and appreciation, $n. Of course, it just occurred to me that there's something else that we need to take care of!
english.completed: Return to Rina Moonspring at Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 愤怒的火灵和地灵
text.objectives: 使用灵魂图腾俘获8个土之魂和8个火之魂，然后向影月谷诅咒祭坛的大地治愈者托洛克复命。
text.description: 我们必须设法挽救现在的局面。跟这片区域的元素沟通，看看有什么补救措施！$B$B$R，我将灵魂图腾交给你。如果你在图腾附近杀死暴怒的元素之灵，灵魂图腾将吸收它们的灵魂。使用图腾吸收元素生物的灵魂，然后向我复命。$B$B首先对付火之灵和土之灵吧，将装满土之魂和火之魂的灵魂图腾交给我。
text.progress: I fear that this land may be without hope.
text.completion: When all of the elemental souls of this region have been placed inside the totem, we will commune with them and find out if anything can be done for Shadowmoon Valley.
text.completed: Return to Earthmender Torlok at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Enraged Spirits of Fire and Earth
english.objectives: Earthmender Torlok at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley wants you to use the Totem of Spirits to capture 8 Earthen Souls and 8 Fiery Souls.
english.description: We must try and make amends. We must commune with the elements of this region and see if anything can be done!$B$BI grant you the totem of spirits, $r. If you slay an enraged elemental spirit in close proximity of the totem, it will consume the elemental's soul. You must use the totem to consume many souls before you may return to me.$B$BDo this for the spirits of fire and earth first. Return to me when the totem is full.
english.progress: I fear that this land may be without hope.
english.completion: When all of the elemental souls of this region have been placed inside the totem, we will commune with them and find out if anything can be done for Shadowmoon Valley.
english.completed: Return to Earthmender Torlok at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 塞纳里奥远征队的崇敬
text.objectives: 塞纳里奥庇护所的伊谢尔·风歌要求你在塞纳里奥远征队中达到崇敬声望。
text.description: $N，你取得的成就，我们有目共睹。你所做的完全超出我们的预想。$B$B我有一项特殊的请求，但是在那之前，我必须考验你对塞纳里奥远征队的忠心。

english.title: Revered Among the Cenarion Expedition
english.objectives: Ysiel Windsinger at the Cenarion Refuge wants you to become revered with the Cenarion Expedition.
english.description: We've taken notice of your accomplishments, $N.  What you've done for us goes beyond what we expect from our allies.$B$BI've a special request to ask of you, but I must test your dedication first.

text.title: 先知的誓约
text.objectives: 当你在流沙之鳞中的声望达到尊敬后，将永恒之戒交给时空之穴的索莉多米。
text.description: $C，你既然做出了承诺，就要实现自己的诺言。$B$B为流沙之鳞效力，你就会获得应得的奖励。如果你失败的话，历史的进程将被破坏！
text.progress: You continue to serve us well, $n.
text.completion: You've proved your worth, $r.  Up to a certain point, at least. The favor of Nozdormu's prime mate is not obtained easily.

english.title: Sage's Vow
english.objectives: Bring your Band of Eternity to Soridormi at the Caverns of Time after obtaining Honored reputation with the Scale of the Sands.
english.description: You've made your pledge, $c.  Now it is up to you to see it through.$B$BServe the Scale of the Sands well and you will be rewarded.$B$BFail and the timeline as we know it will be unravelled!
english.progress: You continue to serve us well, $n.
english.completion: You've proved your worth, $r.  Up to a certain point, at least. The favor of Nozdormu's prime mate is not obtained easily.

text.description: $N，你实现了自己的诺言。为此，你获得了青铜龙的赏识。$B$B只要你继续维护发生在海加尔山的历史事件的正常进程，那么我将不断在永恒之戒中注入力量，直至达到它所能容纳的能量的颠峰。这一天不会太远的。
text.progress: You've returned.  You wish to speak to me?
text.completion: You are a worthy ally indeed.  As you grow in power so does the band of eternity!

english.title: Sage's Oath
english.objectives: Bring your Band of Eternity to Soridormi at the Caverns of Time after obtaining Revered reputation with the Scale of the Sands.
english.description: You've carried out the promise you made to us, $N.  And for that you've gained the recognition you deserve.$B$BAs you continue to become attuned with past events surrounding mount Hyjal, I can continue to tap into the power contained in your ring.  It won't be long until it has reached its full potential.
english.progress: You've returned.  You wish to speak to me?
english.completion: You are a worthy ally indeed.  As you grow in power so does the band of eternity!

text.title: 先知的盟约
text.objectives: 当你在流沙之鳞中的声望达到崇拜后，将永恒之戒交给时空之穴的索莉多米。
text.description: $N，你取得的成就已经超越了我的想象。$B$B与青铜龙一样，你能自由地穿行在时空中。你注定会成为一名强者，而我非常乐意帮你达成这一目标。$B$B继续为流沙之鳞效力吧，我将继续在永恒之戒中注入力量，直至达到它所能容纳的能量的颠峰。
text.progress: May time always be on your side, $n.
text.completion: You are one with time, $n.  You are one with us. Behold!  Power beyond mortal understanding is unleashed from even that small remnant of the Well of Eternity. Accept this gift so that all may know of your covenant with the Scale of the Sands.... so that all may know of your covenant with time itself!

english.title: Sage's Covenant
english.objectives: Bring your Band of Eternity to Soridormi at the Caverns of Time after obtaining Exalted reputation with the Scale of the Sands.
english.description: Your accomplishments have gone beyond my greatest expectations, $N.$B$BYou step in and out of time as comfortably as any bronze dragon I've known.  You are destined for great power and I am more than pleased to help you on your way there.$B$BContinue to serve the Scale of the Sands and I will unleash your gift's full potential.

text.title: 强悍的敌人
text.objectives: 塔拉的监护者莫布吉尔要你从纳格兰的食人魔身上收集10串黑曜石作战念珠。
text.description: 想要证明你对我们的忠诚，就勇敢地与我们的敌人作战吧。$B$B残忍野蛮的食人魔是塔拉最大的威胁。因此，如果你想证明自己的实力，就把他们脖子上的作战念珠带回来给我。我会将你的功绩告诉氏族其他成员的。
text.progress: Well, $n?  Are you all talk or do you have something to show me?
text.completion: You're starting to prove your worth as an ally and combatant.  Keep up the good work.
text.completed: Return to Warden Moi'bff Jill at Telaar in Nagrand.

english.title: Fierce Enemies
english.objectives: Warden Moi'bff Jill at Telaar wants you to obtain 10 Obsidian Warbeads from the various ogres that inhabit Nagrand.
english.description: If you seek to prove your loyalty to us, there is no better way than to fight against our enemies.$B$BOf these, there are none that can match the ogres in strength and fierceness.  Bring me the warbeads they wear around their necks as proof of their demise and I'll let the others know of your prowess.
english.progress: Well, $n?  Are you all talk or do you have something to show me?
english.completion: You're starting to prove your worth as an ally and combatant.  Keep up the good work.
english.completed: Return to Warden Moi'bff Jill at Telaar in Nagrand.

text.title: 更多作战念珠
text.completion: You continue to prove your worth to us, $n.  May your strength never fail you.
text.completed: Return to Warden Moi'bff Jill at Telaar in Nagrand.

english.title: More Warbeads
english.completion: You continue to prove your worth to us, $n.  May your strength never fail you.
english.completed: Return to Warden Moi'bff Jill at Telaar in Nagrand.

text.title: 更多作战念珠！
text.completion: You continue to prove your strength and honor, $n.
text.completed: Return to Warden Bullrok in Zangarmarsh.

english.title: More Warbeads!
english.completion: You continue to prove your strength and honor, $n.
english.completed: Return to Warden Bullrok in Zangarmarsh.

text.title: 证明你的力量
text.objectives: 加拉达尔的监护者布罗克要你从纳格兰的食人魔身上收集10串黑曜石作战念珠。
text.description: 平静的生活谁不向往？可是我们不得不面对许多敌对势力的挑战。残忍野蛮的食人魔是加拉达尔最大的威胁。$B$B如果你想证明自己的实力，就把他们脖子上的作战念珠带回来给我。我会将你取得的成就告诉氏族其他成员的。
text.progress: 你有什么东西要给我看？
text.completion: You are a strong ally indeed, $n.  Going head to head against the ogres of Outland is not something that just anyone can do.
text.completed: Return to Warden Bullrok at Garadar in Nagrand.

english.title: Proving Your Strength
english.objectives: Warden Bullrok at Garadar wants you to obtain 10 Obsidian Warbeads from the various ogres that inhabit Nagrand.
english.description: Though we seek a peaceful life, our enemies are many.  Of these, none match the ogres in sheer brute power.$B$BIf you seek to prove your prowess to us, bring me the warbeads they wear around their necks.  I will tell others of your accomplishments.
english.progress: You have something to show me, $n?
english.completion: You are a strong ally indeed, $n.  Going head to head against the ogres of Outland is not something that just anyone can do.
english.completed: Return to Warden Bullrok at Garadar in Nagrand.

text.title: 愤怒的水灵
text.objectives: Earthmender Torlok at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley wants you to use the Totem of Spirits to capture 5 Watery Souls.$B$B
text.description: The Illidari naga of the region have taken control of the only clean water supply that exists in Shadowmoon Valley.$B$BDirectly north of here you will find the lair of the naga: Coilskar. Around Coilskar are pockets of agitated water that howl to the land in anguish. It is at those pockets that the enraged spirits of water now wander.$B$BTravel to Coilskar and use the totem of spirits to capture watery souls. You will find the largest concentration of these spirits near Coilskar Cistern.$B$B
text.progress: Wherever you find naga you will almost certainly find tortured water spirits.
text.completion: Only air remains, $n.
text.completed: Return to Earthmender Torlok at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Enraged Spirits of Water
english.objectives: Earthmender Torlok at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley wants you to use the Totem of Spirits to capture 5 Watery Souls.$B$B
english.description: The Illidari naga of the region have taken control of the only clean water supply that exists in Shadowmoon Valley.$B$BDirectly north of here you will find the lair of the naga: Coilskar. Around Coilskar are pockets of agitated water that howl to the land in anguish. It is at those pockets that the enraged spirits of water now wander.$B$BTravel to Coilskar and use the totem of spirits to capture watery souls. You will find the largest concentration of these spirits near Coilskar Cistern.$B$B
english.progress: Wherever you find naga you will almost certainly find tortured water spirits.
english.completion: Only air remains, $n.
english.completed: Return to Earthmender Torlok at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 愤怒的气灵
text.objectives: 使用灵魂图腾俘获10个气之魂，然后向影月谷诅咒祭坛的大地治愈者托洛克复命。
text.description: 英雄，往东南方前进吧。当你看见大片破土而出的巨型蓝色水晶时，就说明你的目的地灵翼平原到了。暴怒的空气之灵在平原四周的悬崖和山岭附近游荡。$B$B杀死这些被折磨的元素生物，使用灵魂图腾俘获气之魂。完成任务后回来向我复命。
text.progress: Soon, we will speak with the spirits.
text.completion: Allow me to reward you for undertaking such an arduous task, hero. Now, we must get to work! Please stand back so that I may place the totem and unleash the souls.
text.completed: Return to Earthmender Torlok at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley.

english.title: Enraged Spirits of Air
english.objectives: Earthmender Torlok at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley wants you to use the Totem of Spirits to capture 10 Airy Souls.
english.description: Venture southeast, hero. When you see fields of gigantic blue crystals jutting out from the land, you will have reached your destination. It is there, at the Netherwing Fields, that you will find the enraged spirits of air. They roam the cliffs and mountain bases that surround the fields.$B$BDestroy their tortured forms and capture their souls with the totem of spirits. Return to me when this is done.
english.progress: Soon, we will speak with the spirits.
english.completion: Allow me to reward you for undertaking such an arduous task, hero. Now, we must get to work! Please stand back so that I may place the totem and unleash the souls.
english.completed: Return to Earthmender Torlok at the Altar of Damnation in Shadowmoon Valley.

text.title: 邪兽人清理者
text.objectives: 杀死20个噬骨兽人，然后向荣耀堡的阿曼蒂复命。
text.description: 噬骨清理者躲藏在荒废的城垛上，窥视着荣耀之路的动向。我们相信，这帮邪兽人正在替地狱火堡垒中的主子收集战争机器的组件——必须阻止他们！$B$B$N，荣耀堡北边聚集了大批噬骨兽人。去杀死他们！但是不可掉以轻心，虽然噬骨兽人是邪兽人氏族中不起眼的一支，但是他们的力量跟那些绿皮兽人不相上下……
text.completion: Very good.  I'm sure their loss will be felt in Hellfire Citadel.  Although that dark bastion looms over us and seems nigh insurmountable, it is only with bold moves like you have made that we will find victory over the fel orcs!
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Amadi at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Fel Orc Scavengers
english.objectives: Kill 20 Bonechewer Orcs and return to Amadi in Honor Hold.
english.description: Scavengers, orcs of the Bonechewer clan, skulk about the ruined battlements overlooking the Path of Glory.  We must assume that these fel orcs are gathering war machine parts for their masters within Hellfire Citadel -- they must be stopped!$B$BFind Bonechewer orcs to the north, $n.  Find them and slay them!  But use caution, for although these orcs are the lesser of the fel orc clans, their strength is the match of any green-skinned orc we've faced thus far...
english.completion: Very good.  I'm sure their loss will be felt in Hellfire Citadel.  Although that dark bastion looms over us and seems nigh insurmountable, it is only with bold moves like you have made that we will find victory over the fel orcs!
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Amadi at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 邪恶的咒语
text.objectives: 荣耀堡的阿曼蒂中尉要你前往远征军岗哨，将1枚被诅咒的护符交给埃隆雷下士。
text.description: $N，在与血环邪兽人交战时，我们发现他们身上佩戴着某种不祥的饰物。那些邪兽人从荣耀堡士兵的尸体上取下徽章，制作成被诅咒的护符。我们担心血环兽人利用黑暗魔法将我们的徽章变成了咒符，还用来对付我们！$B$B前往荣耀堡以东的塞斯高，从血环兽人手中夺得一枚被诅咒的护符，然后将它交给塞斯高东北方远征军岗哨的埃隆雷下士。
text.progress: Reporting from Honor Hold, $n?  That's good -- our campaign against the demons and the fel orcs is running thin on able bodies!
text.completion: Ah, you recovered an insignia from the Bleeding Hollow orcs?  Good -- it is outrageous that they use our own symbols against us, and mock our comrades who've fallen to those red-skinned beasts!
text.completed: Return to Corporal Ironridge at Expedition Point in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Ill Omens
english.objectives: Lieutenant Amadi in Honor Hold wants you to bring 1 Cursed Talisman to Corporal Ironridge at Expedition Point.
english.description: $n, in our battles with the Bleeding Hollow clan of fel orcs, we have found upon them foreboding trinkets.  These orcs have collected the insignias of fallen Honor Hold soldiers and created cursed talismans from them.  We fear the dark magic of the Bleeding Hollow orcs have transformed our insignias into evil charms with powers against us!$B$BFind such a talisman from the Bleeding Hollow orcs of Zeth'Gor, to the east, and bring it to Corporal Ironridge at Expedition Point, northeast of Zeth'Gor.
english.progress: Reporting from Honor Hold, $n?  That's good -- our campaign against the demons and the fel orcs is running thin on able bodies!
english.completion: Ah, you recovered an insignia from the Bleeding Hollow orcs?  Good -- it is outrageous that they use our own symbols against us, and mock our comrades who've fallen to those red-skinned beasts!
english.completed: Return to Corporal Ironridge at Expedition Point in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 被诅咒的护符
text.objectives: 将12枚被诅咒的护符交给远征军岗哨的埃隆雷下士。
text.description: $N，我们绝对不能让血环兽人继续利用被诅咒的护符！你必须替我们夺回护符，让那些牺牲的荣耀堡士兵们得到应有的尊重。$B$B前往血环兽人被诅咒的据点塞斯高，执行这项艰巨的任务……集齐护符后返回荣耀堡向我复命。
text.progress: Do you have the talismans, $n?  It pains me to know that those cursed orcs possess our soldiers insignias...
text.completion: Thank you, $n.  My heart is saddened to see these talismans -- they underline the great losses we of Honor Hold have suffered against the fel orcs.  But I am heartened to see you successful against them.  If we can kill enough, perhaps we might emerge from this war victorious.
text.completed: Return to Corporal Ironridge at Expedition Point in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Cursed Talismans
english.objectives: Bring 12 Cursed Talismans to Corporal Ironridge at Expedition Point.
english.description: $n, we cannot allow the Bleeding Hollow orcs to possess their cursed talismans!  You must acquire them for us so they may be disposed of, and so the soldiers who owned them may be honored for their sacrifices.$B$BGo to Zeth'Gor, the cursed abode of the Bleeding Hollow, and perform your grim task... return to me when you have collected the talismans.
english.progress: Do you have the talismans, $n?  It pains me to know that those cursed orcs possess our soldiers insignias...
english.completion: Thank you, $n.  My heart is saddened to see these talismans -- they underline the great losses we of Honor Hold have suffered against the fel orcs.  But I am heartened to see you successful against them.  If we can kill enough, perhaps we might emerge from this war victorious.
english.completed: Return to Corporal Ironridge at Expedition Point in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 血环督军
text.objectives: 把督军摩尔肯的破碎护甲交给远征军岗哨的埃隆雷下士。
text.description: 你能够幸运地从塞斯高安然返回，足以证明你具备优秀的作战能力！现在，我有一项艰巨的任务要交给你，希望这次好运气还能伴随你……$B$B督军摩尔肯坐镇于塞斯高的兵营，指挥着他的邪兽人军团与我们作战。他的战术灵活而残忍，我必须承认，他重挫了我军的士气。因此，$N，我命令你除掉摩尔肯。将他的护甲带回来，我要将它放在这儿示众，鼓舞军中的将士。
text.progress: Do you have Morkh's shattered armor?  Have you braved Zeth'Gor again?
text.completion: You've done it!  Morkh is slain!  Now, we have a fighting chance against the fel orc beasts! Thank you, $n.  Your aid to the war effort here is beyond measure.
text.completed: Return to Corporal Ironridge at Expedition Point in Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: Warlord of the Bleeding Hollow
english.objectives: Bring Warlord Morkh's Shattered Armor to Corporal Ironridge in Expedition Point.
english.description: You have shown great strength and fortune, for you have delved into Zeth'Gor and lived!  Now, let us hope your fortune holds, for I have a dire task to ask of you...$B$BWarlord Morkh sits within the barracks of Zeth'Gor, commanding his fel troops against us.  His tactics are as clever as they are cruel, and I must admit that his successes against us have cut deep.  And so, $n, I ask you to remove Morkh from his seat.  Bring me his armor so that we might display it for our soldiers and bolster them.
english.progress: Do you have Morkh's shattered armor?  Have you braved Zeth'Gor again?
english.completion: You've done it!  Morkh is slain!  Now, we have a fighting chance against the fel orc beasts! Thank you, $n.  Your aid to the war effort here is beyond measure.
english.completed: Return to Corporal Ironridge at Expedition Point in Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 危险的荒野
text.objectives: Slay 12 Bladewing Bloodletters.
text.description: The Thunderlord were once a proud orc clan before they were transformed into fel orcs through the blood of Mannoroth.$B$BRecently we recovered this orc stronghold from the ogres that infest the ravine below.  They had moved in when the Thunderlord clan abandoned it.$B$BWe will keep this place and I will have your help doing so.$B$BIn the Jagged Ridge to the south and the west, there are bloodletters that have become like a plague upon us.  They eat and breed incessantly.$B$BKill them and then return to me.
text.completion: That didn't take as long as I thought it would.  Are you sure that you dealt with as many as was necessary? Very well, there's something else that I want you to help us with.  Something far more important.
text.completed: Return to Gor'drek at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: The Encroaching Wilderness
english.objectives: Slay 12 Bladewing Bloodletters.
english.description: The Thunderlord were once a proud orc clan before they were transformed into fel orcs through the blood of Mannoroth.$B$BRecently we recovered this orc stronghold from the ogres that infest the ravine below.  They had moved in when the Thunderlord clan abandoned it.$B$BWe will keep this place and I will have your help doing so.$B$BIn the Jagged Ridge to the south and the west, there are bloodletters that have become like a plague upon us.  They eat and breed incessantly.$B$BKill them and then return to me.
english.completion: That didn't take as long as I thought it would.  Are you sure that you dealt with as many as was necessary? Very well, there's something else that I want you to help us with.  Something far more important.
english.completed: Return to Gor'drek at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: Dust from the Drakes
text.objectives: Collect 4 Dusts of the Fey Drake.
text.description: The Alliance has recently moved in to the west, using their elven magics to grow a town and grove in a short matter of time.  We must keep their defenses weak so that they do not also grow a spine.$B$BI have a plan that will do that and more.  I want you to traverse the bridge to the southwest, which crosses over Bloodmaul Ravine and leads into the Living Grove.$B$BAttack their fey drake defenses in the Living Grove and bring back the magical dust that sometimes can be found upon their wings.
text.progress: It would seem that the Alliance is determined to follow us wherever we go.  Let us teach them that we are not intimidated by their presence. Do you have that which I have requested?
text.completion: Not only have you weakened their defenses, but we're going to put this dust to use in bolstering our own defenses against the Alliance.
text.completed: Return to Gor'drek at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.completion: Not only have you weakened their defenses, but we're going to put this dust to use in bolstering our own defenses against the Alliance.
english.completed: Return to Gor'drek at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 自我保护
text.objectives: Use Gor'drek's Ointment on 5 of the Thunderlord Dire Wolves.
text.description: With the magical dust you recovered, I have fashioned a magic ointment that will aid in our own defenses.$B$BOur dire wolves are the perfect combination of mount, sentry and friend, but the Alliance scum have been poaching them in the Jagged Ridge.$B$B$N, I want you to take this ointment and apply it to our dire wolf friends.  The Alliance will get a rude surprise the next time that they send one of their hunting parties.$B$BBe aware though that some of the wolves may not like this, and will turn on you.
text.progress: How fares the bolstering of our Thunderlord dire wolves' defenses?
text.completion: Now that you have strengthened the wolves, and the Jagged Ridge's defenses, perhaps we can refocus our attentions on more deadly matters, such as the ogres? You have done a good job in aiding us here.  We could use the help of someone capable, such as yourself, should you decide to stay. Whatever you do, you have earned my respect and appreciation.
text.completed: Return to Gor'drek at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.title: Protecting Our Own
english.objectives: Use Gor'drek's Ointment on 5 of the Thunderlord Dire Wolves.
english.description: With the magical dust you recovered, I have fashioned a magic ointment that will aid in our own defenses.$B$BOur dire wolves are the perfect combination of mount, sentry and friend, but the Alliance scum have been poaching them in the Jagged Ridge.$B$B$N, I want you to take this ointment and apply it to our dire wolf friends. You have done a good job in aiding us here.  We could use the help of someone capable, such as yourself, should you decide to stay. Whatever you do, you have earned my respect and appreciation.
english.completed: Return to Gor'drek at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

text.title: 追杀战争古树
text.objectives: Collect Stronglimb Deeproot's Trunk.
text.description: WANTED!$B$BStronglimb Deeproot, ancient of war and chief defender of the Living Grove south of Sylvanaar.$B$BFind him by heading west across the bridge that traverses the Bloodmaul Ravine.$B$BReturn his hewn trunk to Tor'chunk Twoclaws.
text.progress: What's that you have there?  You're a strong one!
text.completion: Stronglimb Deeproot's Trunk!  Did you chop him down by yourself? I bet you did.  You know, Rexxar and I are looking for a young, strong $c, such as yourself, to help out around here, especially with the problems we continually have with the ogres.  Make sure that you follow-up with me on that possibility. Well that trunk's definitely proof, which means you're here to collect the bounty and not to listen to me talk.  Go ahead, take your pick.
text.completed: Return to Tor'chunk Twoclaws at Thunderlord Stronghold in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

english.objectives: Collect Stronglimb Deeproot's Trunk.
english.description: WANTED!$B$BStronglimb Deeproot, ancient of war and chief defender of the Living Grove south of Sylvanaar.$B$BFind him by heading west across the bridge that traverses the Bloodmaul Ravine.$B$BReturn his hewn trunk to Tor'chunk Twoclaws.

text.title: 水之召唤
text.objectives: Speak with Farseer Nobundo at the Crystal Hall inside the Exodar on Azuremyst Isle.
text.description: I'm sensing that it's been a while since last you were tested.  This is because Farseer Nobundo has been asking for you.$B$BYou must have grown greatly in wisdom because you are being called to learn the mysteries of the element of water.$B$BI trust that you remember how to take the boat from Auberdine in Darkshore on Kalimdor back to the Exodar?  And that you remember where to find the farseer at the Crystal Hall inside the Exodar, yes?
